title: AI-Driven Reproducibility and Analytical Robustness in Scientific Discovery
title_zh: AI驱动的科学发现可复现性与分析鲁棒性研究
abstract: Reproducible and analytically robust research findings are essential to scientific progress, but evaluating these properties typically requires costly manual effort. We investigate whether LLM agents can help automate reproduction and robustness analysis, using a medical case study grounded in the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database, a widely used U.S. cancer registry underlying tens of thousands of published studies. First, we introduce SEER-Repro, a benchmark of 20 published SEER-based papers together with the data and resources required to reproduce their findings. Second, we create an AI agent that successfully reproduces 77.4% of 2,190 atomic claims, while providing executable baselines for further analysis. Third, we develop an agentic analysis pipeline to test the robustness of the medical findings by identifying analytical choices underlying each finding, proposing defensible alternatives, and rerunning the analysis to determine whether those choices affect the conclusion. Across published papers in SEER-Repro, our pipeline identifies potentially consequential analytical choices in 9.5% of fully reproduced findings and flags them for expert review. These results show how LLM agents can support scientific review by reproducing findings, systematically testing their robustness, and directing expert attention toward potentially consequential analytical choices.
summary_zh: 科学发现的可复现性与鲁棒性评估依赖昂贵人工，本研究探索利用LLM agent实现该过程的自动化。
构建SEER-Repro基准，并开发AI agent成功复现77.4%的原子声明，同时提供可执行基线。
提出智能体分析管线测试医学发现鲁棒性，在9.5%的复现结果中识别出潜在关键分析选择并标记供专家审查。

title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
title_zh: DiscoveryRSI：递归学习发现有价值假设
abstract: Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. We introduce an operational definition of valuable and testable research hypotheses: evidence-grounded claims about consequential uncertainties, coupled with feasible investigations, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations. Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.
summary_zh: 科学发现需将假设转化为实际研究，但从此演进过程中学习仍具挑战，需定义有价值且可检验的假设。
提出DiscoveryRSI框架，通过多智能体进化搜索构建假设树，并经信用优化、策略回放与重发现三种机制递归学习。
在四个生命科学领域验证，假设质量自4.86升至5.39；人工评估显示其27B模型在重要性与合理性上优于GPT-6 Luna。

title: Leveraging verifiable structure in quantum circuits to find more efficient compilations with agentic AI
title_zh: 利用量子电路可验证结构结合智能体AI寻找更高效编译
abstract: We discuss an effective paradigm of utilizing AI agents to better compile quantum circuits when one can constrain bottleneck subroutines to have some form of classically verifiable structure. For example, when critical subroutines are composed exclusively of reversible classical logic, phasing operations, and measurement based uncomputation, one can efficiently simulate execution for classical inputs. This property facilitates efficient certification of approximate circuit synthesis via a form of fuzz testing, provided suitable assumptions on the input distribution. While this pattern was recently exploited to improve quantum cryptanalysis circuits, here we highlight the flexibility of the broader approach by discussing three important applications. (1) The computation of $1/\sqrt{x}$ that bottlenecks real space simulations of the Coulomb operator such as those important for modeling inertial confinement fusion reactors. (2) The decoding of Reed-Solomon codes which bottlenecks the decoded quantum interferometry algorithm when used to approximately solve the optimal polynomial intersection problem. And (3) the quantum look-up tables and controlled application of Givens rotations that bottleneck the most performant quantum algorithms for simulating chemistry in second quantization. We discuss reference implementations of these algorithms and how they can be constrained and verified in the interest of seeding a Kaggle competition designed to accelerate AI-based research into the optimization of their compilation.
summary_zh: 量子电路编译难验证，若瓶颈子程序具可验证结构，可用模糊测试高效验证近似合成。
提出用AI agent优化此类电路编译，通过约束子程序结构实现高效验证与优化。
展示该方法在库仑算符模拟、RS码解码及化学模拟等三种关键应用中的灵活性。

title: Beyond the Answer: Student-Conditioned Trace Construction for Reasoning Distillation
abstract: A reasoning trace can accompany a correct answer without providing effective supervision for a particular student. We study how to construct traces that improve learning beyond answer-only supervision by considering both their intermediate content and their accessibility to the target learner. We introduce ReDiST, a student-conditioned trace-construction and distillation framework for evidence-rich reasoning. Starting from the student's own attempts, ReDiST revises answer-correct drafts against the supplied evidence and repairs unsuccessful drafts with additional guidance from the verified answer. A frozen student-matched reader screens and ranks original and edited candidates using answer recovery and verified-answer probability, given the question, evidence, and candidate trace. We distill the selected targets while balancing trace and final-answer supervision with an auxiliary answer loss. Construction and selection occur offline, and inference uses only the distilled student. Experiments on question-answering benchmarks show that ReDiST can improve both source-task and cross-benchmark performance over answer-only, original-trace, and the evaluated trace-selection and rewriting baselines. Across supervision recipes, performance rankings can differ between source and transfer benchmarks, highlighting the importance of evaluating trace teaching utility across distributions.

title: Self-Building Labs
title_zh: 自建实验室：面向科学目标的自动化实验构建系统
abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) accelerate scientific discovery by automating experimental execution and optimization. AI agents can increasingly propose new experiments, but existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still takes extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery. We introduce the self-building laboratory (SBL), which designs, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup given a high-level scientific goal. SBL starts from whatever already exists, from an empty room to a working SDL, and builds the missing capabilities: the lab layout, its digital twin, robot skills, and experimental workflows. We demonstrate the system working across different robots and setups, scaling from a single workstation to laboratories with several robots working together. We validate SBL's end-to-end capabilities through a real-world quantum-dot synthesis experiment. By shifting the role of human researchers from manually configuring and programming device automation to specifying scientific objectives, SBL makes scientific automation more accessible, flexible, and scalable. Project website: https://self-building-labs.github.io/
summary_zh: 现有自动驾驶实验室难以适应新实验，手动改造耗时，灵活性成为扩展科学发现的瓶颈。
提出自建实验室（SBL），根据高层科学目标自动设计、配置并运行实验，补齐缺失的布局、数字孪生与工作流。
在多机器人协同及量子点合成实验中验证了SBL的端到端能力，使科研人员仅需指定目标，提升自动化灵活性与可扩展性。

title: CocoRNA: Collective RNA Design with Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: CocoRNA：基于协作多智能体强化学习的RNA设计
abstract: Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem. We propose CocoRNA, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for RNA inverse design. CocoRNA simplifies the design task by decomposing it into smaller sub-problems, each solved collaboratively by multiple agents. This approach reduces the complexity of the problem and improves the exploration of design policies. During training, a centralized critic uses global structural information to guide the agents, enabling them to jointly optimize their design strategies. As a result, CocoRNA learns high-quality RNA design policies that generalize effectively to unseen structures without additional training. Experiments on the Rfam dataset demonstrate that CocoRNA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design speed. Further experiments on other biological sequence design tasks highlight the effectiveness and broad potential of CocoRNA for complex design tasks.
summary_zh: RNA逆设计计算复杂，需寻找能折叠成目标结构的序列。
提出CocoRNA框架，将任务分解为子问题由多智能体协作求解，并经集中式评论家引导联合优化策略。
该方法在Rfam数据集上显著提升成功率与速度，且无需额外训练即可泛化至未知结构。

title: Acceptance Is Not Speed: Length Inflation in Training-Free Lossy Speculative Decoding
abstract: Speculative decoding typically characterizes speedup by draft tokens accepted per verification round. Lossless verification preserves the target model's output distribution and thus expected completion length, making this metric a meaningful efficiency proxy. Relaxed (lossy) verification accepts tokens that lossless verification would reject, potentially altering that distribution. We identify a length inflation phenomenon: relaxed verification lengthens completions, primarily by extending reasoning traces, largely offsetting apparent gains in accepted tokens per round. We evaluate existing training-free relaxed verification rules on twelve target-drafter pairs against lossless verification on identical prompts, measuring completion length, verifier rounds, wall-clock time, and task accuracy. At each rule's most relaxed evaluated setting, relaxed verification on average accepts $1.34\times$ as many tokens per round but produces $1.54\times$ longer completions. For rules with higher acceptance lengths, tokens accepted only under relaxed verification tend to have low target-model probability, contributing to length inflation. For rules that reduce verifier rounds, accuracy typically drops substantially. Further analysis traces some failures to continued reasoning that exhausts the budget needed to deliver a final answer. Overall, accepted tokens per round alone is an unreliable measure of decoding speed under relaxed verification. Completion length and verifier rounds must also be reported to assess actual efficiency.

title: Jarvis: Coordination Deserves a Brain of Its Own in Agentic Interactive Models
title_zh: Jarvis：交互式智能体中协调机制需独立大脑
abstract: Interactive models increasingly hand complex reasoning and tool use to a slow brain in the background, leaving a realtime front model free to sustain full-duplex dialogue. Yet the user may refine, cancel or replace a request while its task runs, so a plan or result that made sense a moment ago goes stale. Each new utterance must therefore be read against the work in flight, but the front model follows only the conversation and the back end sees only its own task. Coordination deserves a brain of its own, one that sees both. We introduce Jarvis, a coordination harness where models judge and code enforces. Its typed decision model, JEV, reads each turn against the live tasks and picks among operations built from a versioned task record. Code checks every choice against the current state before applying it, so no decision can act on a task version the user has replaced. Jarvis also rechecks plans before they execute and results before they are spoken, and counts an answer as delivered only once the user has heard it in full. We build two instances of this design. Jarvis-Audio runs unchanged on three full-duplex speech models. Jarvis-Omni adds vision and rechecks the evidence behind an answer before and during playback, since a scene can change while nobody speaks. With the front model and back end held fixed, replacing Qwen Audio Agent with Jarvis raises tau-Voice task success more than sixfold, from 29 to 192 of 278 tasks, and the gains hold on every benchmark and front model. Against published systems, Jarvis-Audio reaches 69% Pass1 on Full-Duplex-Bench v3 with an open 9B front model, versus 60% for GPT-Realtime. These results suggest that how the two brains are coordinated matters as much as how strong they are.
summary_zh: 交互模型中前后端分离易致任务过期，需独立协调机制同时感知对话与任务状态。
提出Jarvis框架，通过类型化决策模型JEV读取实时任务，并用代码强制校验状态，防止操作过期任务。
实验表明，Jarvis使任务成功数提升超六倍，且其9B模型性能超越GPT-Realtime，证明协调机制与模型能力同等重要。

title: DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery
title_zh: DrugHarness：面向计算药物发现的可进化智能体框架
abstract: Computational drug discovery requires agents to compose scientific operations and adapt to changing evidence and constraints. Here we introduce DrugHarness, an evolvable agent harness coupling composable scientific execution with conditional skill induction. Its environment integrates over 80 scientific operations, biomedical resources and task-specific code, preserving associations among candidates, results and artifacts. From execution trajectories and outcome feedback, DrugHarness induces action hypotheses with observable applicability conditions, recommended actions and supporting evidence. An independent review agent evaluates candidate skills derived from these hypotheses through source verification and, when needed, targeted execution trials. Admitted skills guide subsequent tasks and are revised through feedback. Evaluation on MolBench and SMDD-Bench demonstrates capabilities in molecular screening, optimization and constrained design. Without evolution, DrugHarness exceeds reported MolClaw-CC results by 10.8 percentage points in affinity-comparison accuracy and 55% in mean top-three active hits on MolBench. Retrospective evaluation on skill-development tasks shows that evolution increases Qwen's affinity-comparison accuracy from 62.2% to 81.1% and optimization success from 79.5% to 87.2%. In a prospective HPK1 study, DrugHarness achieves a more favorable median docking score than Biomni among system-specific candidates. A synthesized compound achieves a cellular IC50 of 14.19 nM, a 2.64-fold potency improvement over the best input reference, with activity competitive with two selected compounds designed by experienced medicinal chemists. These results support conditional skill evolution for scientific agents and demonstrate a workflow connecting computational drug design with experimental validation.
summary_zh: 计算药物发现需智能体组合操作并适应动态约束，为此提出可进化框架DrugHarness，耦合可组合执行与条件技能归纳。
该框架从执行轨迹归纳带适用条件的动作假设，经独立审查Agent验证后准入技能，以反馈修正并指导后续任务。
实验表明该框架在分子筛选等任务上优势显著；技能进化使Qwen亲和力比较准确率提升至81.1%；前瞻研究中合成化合物IC50达14.19nM。

title: Enforcing Code Reasoning in Agentic Scaffold for More Effective Issue Resolution
title_zh: 强化智能体代码推理以提升问题解决效率
abstract: Reasoning is central to ReAct-based programming agents, yet whether and how they reason about code remains unclear. We study 7,955 issue-resolution trajectories from six single- and multi-agent scaffolds across four programming languages on SWE-bench-Verified, SWE-bench-Pro, and SWE-bench-Lite. We identify 12 forms of code reasoning in 66.95% of trajectories. Code reasoning is associated with higher resolution rates, and its intensity increases with task complexity. However, it remains largely unguided: agents may focus on surface-level symptoms during localization, fail to refine near-correct patches, overlook issue requirements, and generate tests with limited behavioral diversity. To address these limitations, we propose DeskCheck, an agentic scaffold that systematically guides code reasoning throughout repository-level issue resolution. DeskCheck simulates execution paths to localize root causes, simulates candidate patches to refine near-misses, audits patches against issue requirements, and reasons about corner-case inputs and expected outputs before generating tests. On 731 SWE-bench-Pro instances, DeskCheck improves resolution rates over mini-SWE-Agent and Claude Code by 6.29% to 10.53%, at an additional cost of $0.02-$0.28 per instance (average: $0.14). Per-phase analyses show higher method-level localization recall, more successful repairs of imprecisely localized issues, and better detection of missed corner cases in near-correct patches. Exact McNemar tests show statistically significant improvements across all subject LLMs (p < 10^-10), while repeated experiments support robustness to agent nondeterminism. These findings motivate systematic code reasoning as a means of improving programming agents.
summary_zh: 现有编程智能体的代码推理缺乏引导，常导致定位表面化、补丁未精炼及测试多样性不足。
提出 DeskCheck 智能体框架，通过模拟执行定位根因、模拟补丁精炼、审计需求及推理边界用例来系统引导代码推理。
在 SWE-bench-Pro 上，DeskCheck 显著提升问题解决率（6.29%-10.53%），且成本增加极低，统计结果显著。

title: An exact finite-state representation of viscoelastic memory for accelerated sea-level modeling: SLEvolve v1.0
title_zh: 用于加速海平面模拟的黏弹性记忆精确有限状态表示：SLEvolve v1.0
abstract: Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) models solve the gravitationally self-consistent sea-level equation for the response of the solid Earth and the oceans to changing ice loads. As these models are increasingly embedded in coupled ice-sheet simulations, glacial-cycle calculations, and large ensembles, standard pseudo-spectral 1-D solvers face a steep computational barrier: they evaluate the viscoelastic response by explicitly re-summing every past load increment, scaling quadratically with time steps as $O(N^2)$. Here we show that this computational penalty is an artifact of algorithmic formulation rather than Earth physics. By exploiting the exponential form of the viscoelastic relaxation kernel, we reformulate the viscous response as an exact recursive update of a finite set of modal states, without re-summing the load history. This exact reformulation alone reduces the cost of a run to $O(N)$, yielding a 20.6-fold speed-up relative to a standard full-history 1-D GIA solver for a case study involving a 550-step Antarctic future sea-level projection. Implemented in our open-source solver SLEvolve v1.0, this formulation---combined with fewer, table-free and multithreaded spherical-harmonic transforms, improved file handling, and physics-inspired iteration starts---achieves an end-to-end speed-up of over three orders of magnitude (up to 4,000-fold) against the same 1-D GIA solver, reducing day-long simulations to under thirty seconds on a workstation. Beyond this solid-Earth application, SLEvolve illustrates how human-derived analytical reformulations can be combined with benchmark-harnessed AI-assisted engineering to modernize scientific software. In particular, Numerical regression tests and performance profiling guided the AI agents' implementation choices and helped reject ineffective optimizations.
summary_zh: 标准一维GIA求解器重算历史载荷导致计算量随时间步呈O(N²)增长，成为计算瓶颈。
利用黏弹性松弛核的指数形式，将黏滞响应重构为有限模态状态的精确递归更新，避免历史重求和。
该精确重构将复杂度降至O(N)，结合其他优化，端到端加速超3个数量级，并展示了AI辅助工程在科学软件现代化中的作用。

title: VocalGrad: Evaluating Acoustic Perception in Audio Language Models
title_zh: VocalGrad：评估音频语言模型的声学感知能力
abstract: Recent large audio language models (LALMs) have extended their capabilities beyond lexical speech understanding to tasks requiring paralinguistic and non-linguistic audio understanding, such as emotion recognition. However, these models still struggle to reliably utilize acoustic information, particularly when it co-occurs with spoken linguistic content. Existing benchmarks do not clearly distinguish acoustic perception from higher-level reasoning, making it difficult to identify the source of these failures. To address this issue, we introduce VocalGrad, a benchmark designed to evaluate LALMs' ability to perceive low-level acoustic variations. VocalGrad formulates this problem as a simple binary classification of temporal change direction, enabling evaluation largely independent of higher-level reasoning or semantic understanding. Our benchmark results reveal a substantial gap in acoustic perception between human annotators and state-of-the-art LALMs: while human annotators achieve high accuracy, LALMs perform at near-chance levels. We further conduct linear probing to identify structural bottlenecks in these models. Our analysis reveals two distinct failure modes: for some categories, task-relevant information is preserved in internal representations but not utilized by the language model head; for others, the information becomes progressively less linearly decodable across model layers. Overall, our results reveal substantial limitations of LALMs in modeling acoustic variation under controlled settings and expose representation differences not observable from text outputs.
summary_zh: 现有LALMs难以可靠利用声学信息，且现有基准未区分声学感知与高层推理，无法定位失败根源。
提出VocalGrad基准，将声学感知评估转化为时序变化方向的二分类任务，剥离高层语义推理的干扰。
实验表明LALMs声学感知接近随机水平；探针分析揭示其存在信息未利用及跨层信息丢失两种失败模式。

title: Agentic AI for Heterogeneous System Design Across Chip, Scale-Up, and Scale-Out Domains
title_zh: 面向芯片、纵向与横向扩展域的异构系统Agentic AI设计
abstract: The design space of modern AI/HPC systems has expanded rapidly across compute architectures, including GPUs, dataflow processors, and RISC-V accelerators; memory tech- nologies, including HBM, GDDR, and SRAM; and interconnects such as NVLink, UALink, Infinity Fabric, InfiniBand, Slingshot, and Ultra Ethernet. No single architecture is optimal across LLM training, LLM serving, and AI-coupled HPC workloads, while the resulting combinatorial design space is too large for manual exploration. We present ArchAgent, a hierarchical multi- agent framework in which an LLM-based planner decomposes system design into chip, scale-up, and scale-out subproblems, each handled by specialist agents. A deterministic analytical evaluator closes the loop, ensuring that all performance estimates are derived from analytical models rather than generated by the LLM. On a mixed AI+HPC workload under a 1 MW power budget, ArchAgent discovers heterogeneous designs that achieve a 1.93x weighted geometric mean speedup over a homogeneous GPU baseline, while requiring only 18 evaluations compared with 100 evaluations for hill climbing, which achieves 1.65x speedup.
summary_zh: 现代AI/HPC系统设计空间组合爆炸且无单一架构适用所有负载，难以人工探索。
提出ArchAgent分层多智能体框架，LLM规划器将设计分解为芯片、纵向与横向扩展子问题，由专业agent处理。
引入确定性分析评估器闭环，在1MW功耗下实现1.93倍加速，仅需18次评估，优于爬山法的1.65倍。

title: Beyond Large Language Models: A Mental World Model Framework for Mental Modeling, Simulation, Evolution, and Interpretability
title_zh: 超越大语言模型：面向心智建模与演化的心智世界模型框架
abstract: Understanding and simulating how subjective cognition and mental states emerge, evolve, and shape behavior is essential for advancing artificial intelligence toward deeper social cognition and general intelligence. Existing large language models (LLMs) and Theory of Mind (ToM) methods primarily infer mental states from linguistic information, lacking unified mechanisms for subjective world construction, cognitive-psychological interactions, dynamic evolution, and historical dependencies. This paper introduces the Mental World Model (MWM) and its implementation, the Multi-Branch Mental Evolution Architecture (MMEA), which explicitly constructs subjective worlds, models interactions between cognition and mental states, and simulates continuous mental evolution shaped by historical experiences. On DynToM and RecToM, MMEA achieves 96.48% and 94.00% accuracy, respectively, outperforming leading LLMs and specialized ToM methods. Additional experiments demonstrate improvements of 28.7, 39.3, and 16.6 percentage points in mental state and behavior prediction, long-sequence prediction, and implicit mental state inference, respectively. The results demonstrate that MMEA provides an interpretable framework for continuous mental modeling, enabling AI to move beyond surface-level semantic representations to infer individuals' underlying mental states from linguistic information and dynamically simulate their internal cognitive processes and evolution over time. MWM also provides a promising foundation for causal reasoning, personalized AI, sustained human-AI interaction, and future advances toward artificial general intelligence (AGI).
summary_zh: 现有LLM与ToM方法缺乏主观世界构建与心智动态演化的统一机制，难以深层模拟认知与行为。
提出心智世界模型（MWM）及多分支心智演化架构（MMEA），显式构建主观世界并模拟受历史经验塑造的心智连续演化。
MMEA在多项基准上准确率超LLM与专用ToM方法，为连续心智建模提供可解释框架，助力迈向AGI。

title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
title_zh: GLOBE：面向生成式搜索的电商产品结构化智能体记忆进化
abstract: Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.
summary_zh: 现有电商优化将结构化列表视作自由文本，有效策略隐含且难以复用，缺乏可积累的智能体记忆。
提出GLOBE框架，将优化知识存入不断进化的显式行为手册，通过编辑、反思、审核与策展循环实现持续自改进。
实验表明该结构化记忆优于整体提示优化，能降低下行风险，且学到的行为在未见品类上仍具可迁移性。
comment: Accepted to the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models(REALM) at EMNLP 2026

title: "To Boldly Go Where No One Has Gone Before" What Has AI Let Developers Unlock?
title_zh: AI为开发者解锁了哪些新可能
abstract: Measuring AI by how much faster developers work is like judging electricity by how much faster it spun a steam-era factory. A fuller measure asks what new work becomes possible. We surveyed 331 software developers at Microsoft about what AI lets them do that they could not do before and analyzed their answers using reflexive thematic analysis with a human-in-the-loop, multi-model AI council. Developers described doing familiar work faster (Faster, 45%), undertaking work previously beyond their reach (Further, 36.9%), and taking on new kinds of work centered on building for and directing AI agents (Afresh, 12.4%). Across these accounts, learning and scaffolding ran in both directions: developers learned new skills with AI while externalizing their tacit knowledge as the context and standards that guide AI's work. Drawing on Vygotsky's zone of proximal development, we frame developers and AI as joint learners whose zones meet at the skill-judgment nexus: AI can supply skill faster than it can reliably judge its own work, and developers must continuously bridge that gap. Whether they do sets them on one of two paths. On one, developers' judgment grows alongside AI's skill, and they codify what they learn so the loop keeps turning. On the other, they become hollow orchestrators, approving work they can no longer judge and losing the identity and meaning they once drew from it. Based on our findings, we offer a two-way scaffolding playbook to help developers, teams, and tool builders take the first path.
summary_zh: 传统仅衡量AI提效有局限，需探究其带来的新可能。通过对331名微软开发者的调查与主题分析，发现AI不仅加速工作，更拓展了能力边界。
开发者使用AI呈现三种模式：加速原有工作（45%）、触及以往无法完成的工作（36.9%），以及从事围绕构建和指导AI agent的新工作（12.4%）。
AI技能供给快于自身判断，开发者需持续弥补此差距。若判断力随AI成长并外化知识，则良性循环；若盲目审批则沦为空壳指挥者。据此提出双向脚手架指南。

title: Toward Spectral Deferred Correction Methods for Stochastic Differential Equations
title_zh: 面向随机微分方程的谱延迟修正方法
abstract: The numerical solution of stochastic differential equations is computationally very demanding. Often it is of interest to evaluate certain moments, e.g., the expectation, by Monte Carlo sampling, thus requiring the computation of numerous realizations. The discretization error of the numerical scheme induces bias in the computed Monte Carlo estimator. As popular numerical schemes, like Euler-Maruyama or Milstein, are low-order, even reasonably coarse error bounds for the simulation are costly to achieve. While the evaluation of moments requires only weak convergence, in other applications like parameter estimation, strong convergence is important, but higher-order is typically harder to obtain in the strong than in the weak sense. In this paper we develop an efficient method with the potential of achieving higher strong and weak convergence order. It is based on the smooth approximation of Brownian bridges combined with spectral deferred correction methods well known for the numerical solution of ordinary differential equations. We discuss convergence, and present numerical results.
summary_zh: 随机微分方程数值求解计算量大，低阶格式导致蒙特卡洛估计有偏且强收敛难获高阶。
结合布朗桥光滑近似与求解常微分方程的谱延迟修正方法，构建高效数值求解框架。
该方法有望实现高阶强收敛与弱收敛，理论分析了收敛性并给出数值实验验证。

title: Agentic Physics-Grounded Video Generation via Memory-Augmented In-Context Reasoning
title_zh: 基于记忆增强上下文推理的智能体物理视频生成
abstract: Physical plausibility is essential for realistic video generation. Existing methods impose physical guidance before synthesis via simulations or refined prompts, but this can limit dynamic diversity, miss errors that emerge only after generation, and require repeated regeneration when inconsistencies remain. We therefore study a generate-diagnose-repair paradigm that preserves the original generation capability and selectively repairs physical inconsistencies afterward, raising two key questions: what to repair and how to repair? To address them, we introduce PhysRepair, an agentic video generation framework that combines causal reasoning over the observed physical failure with prior repair experience to enable localized and adaptive correction. Specifically, Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints identify the first invalid physical state and its causally affected states, producing a repair specification that guides physically plausible local regeneration while preserving unaffected content. Experience-augmented In-context Learning combines the ongoing repair context with relevant experience from previous repairs, allowing the agent to adapt its repair decisions across diverse physical failures and accumulate completed trajectories for future cases. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified across solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, optics, thermodynamics, and magnetism demonstrate that PhysRepair consistently improves the physical plausibility of generated videos over existing methods. Our project page is available at https://xxkkxxx.github.io/PhysRepair-Website/.
summary_zh: 现有视频生成方法预加物理约束会限制动态多样性且难修事后错误，需研究事后修复范式。
提出PhysRepair框架，通过时空因果约束定位首个无效物理状态及受影响区域，实现局部重生成。
引入经验增强的上下文学习，结合当前修复上下文与历史经验，使智能体自适应修复并积累经验。
实验表明PhysRepair在多物理领域显著提升生成视频的物理合理性。

title: On the possibilities and limitations of LLM-based multi-agent systems for multi-criteria decision-making in healthcare operations management
title_zh: LLM多智能体系统在医疗多准则决策中的潜力与局限
abstract: Multi-criteria models for healthcare operations need weights that express how stakeholders trade off patient waiting time, provider workload, and operating cost, but these weights are difficult to quantify. Teams of large language model (LLM) agents, each prompted to represent a stakeholder, have been used to supply them. We propose a framework for assessing the reliability of LLM-generated preferences as inputs to multi-objective optimization and quantifying how their uncertainty affects decisions. We study explicit preferences by asking agents to rate the importance of the criteria in an outpatient appointment scheduling problem, and implicit preferences by inferring trade-offs from the agents' pairwise choices between emergency department configurations. The computational experiments show that the explicit preferences respond to the clinic's operating conditions and differ across roles, but deliberation among the agents can erase these differences, whereas simple averaging preserves them. The pairwise choices used to reveal the agents' implicit preferences depend largely on which option is presented first, and we find limited evidence that a statistical model using contextual information alongside presentation order predicts the agents' choices on new comparison pairs better than a model using presentation order alone. We then formulate robust weighted-sum optimization models to account for preference uncertainty. In most cases, these models select different schedules or configurations from those obtained using average preference weights. These results indicate that LLM-generated preferences need an audit of this kind before they are used as optimization weights in healthcare decision support.
summary_zh: 医疗多准则决策需量化权衡权重，但难以获取。本文提出评估LLM智能体生成偏好可靠性及量化其不确定性对决策影响的框架。
实验表明LLM显式偏好随条件变化且角色间有差异，但协商会抹平差异；隐式偏好严重受选项呈现顺序影响，且上下文信息预测能力有限。
考虑偏好不确定性的鲁棒优化模型，多数情况下得出不同于平均权重的解。结论：LLM生成偏好作优化权重前必须经过此类审计。

title: OwlSight: A Panoramic Monitor for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
title_zh: OwlSight：思维链推理的全景监控器
abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring offers actionable evidence for oversight AI systems, with the potential to enable early detection and intervention. However, existing approaches are focused on specific tasks, whereas the regulation of AI, particularly reasoning models, requires monitoring a broader range of tasks. We introduce Factor for CoT monitoring, a strategy that supports customizing monitoring requirements in the prompt, which enables a single monitor to cover different tasks by relying on different factors. Furthermore, we introduce two types of factors, fine-grained and coarse-grained (e.g., monitoring whether a specific email address has been leaked versus monitoring privacy leakage), to accommodate diverse user monitoring needs. Based on this, we develop a CoT monitor named OwlSight that relies solely on factor to monitor behaviors related to multiple dimensions, including capability, safety, and trustworthiness. Experiments across 15,971 reasoning trajectories show that OwlSight surpasses general-purpose LLMs by 1.32-30.57 and 11.71-27.81 points at fine and coarse granularity, respectively, and achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenAI's CoT monitorability benchmark. It also generalizes to unseen models' CoTs and remains robust to Factor rephrasings, CoT compression, and obfuscation, offering a promising paradigm for CoT monitoring that can contribute to the oversight of frontier AI.
summary_zh: 现有CoT监控局限于特定任务，难以满足推理模型广泛监管需求，需支持多任务监控。
提出Factor策略，允许在提示词中自定义监控要求，通过细粒度与粗粒度因子使单一监控器覆盖不同任务。
开发OwlSight监控器，实验表明其在细粗粒度上均超越通用LLM并达SOTA，且对未见模型及扰动鲁棒，提供前沿AI监管新范式。

title: Learning Robot Metareasoning: Adaptive Computation Budgets for Real-Time Control
title_zh: 学习机器人元推理：实时控制的自适应计算预算
abstract: Planning while moving faces an historical trade-off between deliberation and reactivity. A planner running concurrently with execution needs time to compute, so the robot must commit to an open-loop action chunk for that duration: a longer commitment buys a better plan at the cost of feedback frequency. Existing controllers fix this action commitment, and consequently the computation budget, before deployment. However, the optimal computation time is highly state-dependent (due to factors such as unmodeled dynamics, safety constraints, and marginal optimisation gains), i.e. dynamic, therefore offline static tuning risks leaving systems blind during critical maneuvers or unable to find global effective solutions. We cast the identification of the optimal computation budget as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) in which a single decision defines both the robot action commitments and the time allocated to the solver. To solve this, we train a reinforcement-learning policy conditioned on the current state, the executing plan, and inexpensive planner statistics. Across ground-robot navigation, agile quadrotor flight, and contact-rich manipulation, the learned policy changes its budget with the demands of the scenario, discovering efficient reasoning patterns that outperform fixed-budget baselines. https://lorenzomagnino.github.io/learning-robot-metareasoning-review/
summary_zh: 移动规划需权衡推理与反应，固定计算预算无法适应状态依赖的最优计算时间，易致关键操作失效。
将最优计算预算识别建模为半马尔可夫决策过程，基于状态与规划统计量训练强化学习策略。
该方法能依场景动态调整预算，发现高效推理模式，在导航、飞行与操控任务中优于固定预算基线。

title: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
title_zh: ABF-Bench：面向代理式区块链取证的可验证基准
abstract: Blockchain forensics is adversarial and open-ended: money launderers split, swap, and bridge funds, cut their trail at mixers or custodial services, and change tactics from one incident to the next. Investigators must keep adapting their tracing in response. Yet the immutability of public ledgers preserves every recorded movement in public view, making much of the investigation independently verifiable. We introduce ABF-Bench, an interactive benchmark that makes evidence-backed fund tracing a verifiable agent task, in which every claimed movement must cite ledger records the agent retrieved. A case-to-task pipeline builds well-posed tasks across ledgers: conservative rules halt tracing wherever the records leave a continuation unresolved, and each task's reference graph is the answer those rules determine. Built from real laundering activity, the tasks combine multi-hop transfers, DeFi exchanges, cross-chain round trips, custodial and mixer deposits, and address poisoning. We also propose the ABF agent harness, built around a working memory, and evaluate it alongside general-purpose agents and fixed-order tracers. The harness reaches 75% edge recall, against 47% for Codex with the same model and 10% for Claude Code, which loses recall to overconfidence: it cites records it left unretrieved. Compared with fixed-order tracers, the harness acquires evidence faster than the best of them early in the budget and recognizes undisclosed custodial services that they walk past (89% vs. 0%), with 98% fidelity. However, agents tend to stop early and lose recall on larger tasks, which holds their final recall below the best tracer. Beyond exposing these gaps, ABF-Bench opens blockchain forensics to LLM agents as a verifiable domain, where the verdicts that score agents also offer potential training signals.
summary_zh: 区块链取证面临洗钱战术多变且开放的问题，提出ABF-Bench基准，将资金追踪转化为可验证的agent任务，要求每步引用账本记录。
针对跨链和DeFi等复杂洗钱活动，构建案例到任务的管道，采用保守规则在记录未决时终止追踪，生成可验证的参考图作为答案。
提出基于工作记忆的ABF agent框架，其边召回率达75%，远超Codex和Claude Code，且能识别未公开托管服务，但agent在大任务上易早停致召回率受限。

title: Certifying information flow in multi-agent behaviours
title_zh: 多智能体行为中的信息流认证
abstract: We study which input-output behaviours of several agents can be produced by a declared communication schedule, that is, a fixed sequence of senders, recipients, message alphabets, and output times, together with shared randomness. Since a schedule admits only finitely many deterministic protocols, membership is a linear program, and an infeasible target is excluded by a separating inequality. Under explicit operational assumptions, we prove that the affine hull of the achievable behaviours is described exactly by the equalities stating that each joint output statistic depends only on the inputs that can reach the agents involved, so that a violated equality identifies both the statistic and the missing input. One binary message per event already attains this affine hull, so message capacity restricts which behaviours are achievable without being visible to any equality. We apply the result to one-bit broadcast and relay hierarchies for two and three agents, and to low-order projections of the local polytope.
summary_zh: 【问题】多智能体输入输出行为是否由声明的通信调度产生难以判定，【方法】将成员判定转化为线性规划问题，【结论】不可行目标可通过分离不等式排除。
【问题】需明确可达行为的仿射包特征，【方法】在操作假设下证明可达行为等式精确描述了输出统计仅依赖可达输入，【结论】违反等式可定位缺失输入与对应统计量。
【问题】消息容量如何影响可达行为，【方法】证明每个事件仅需单比特消息即可达到仿射包，【结论】容量仅限制等式不可见的可达行为，并应用于广播与中继层级分析。
comment: Work in progress; comments welcome. 14 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables

title: ThetreStageAI: Multi-View Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Bengali Theatre Production Planning
title_zh: 面向孟加拉语戏剧制作的结构化多视图RAG框架
abstract: Staging a theatre performance requires coordinating dialogue, actor movement, stage directions, lighting focus, cue timing, and equipment constraints within the same production plan. This work presents ThetreStageAI, a retrieval augmented framework for structured Bengali theatre production planning. Rather than retrieving from one mixed corpus, the system maintains separate scene, actor-blocking, and lighting views. Bengali text is embedded with BGE-M3 and indexed in view-specific Qdrant collections. Retrieved references are combined with a production brief and passed to Gemini, which generates schema-constrained JSON containing characters, scenes, dialogue, stage directions, blocking, lighting, and optional sound cues. Structural and semantic checks are applied before acceptance, with at most one constrained repair attempt. We also construct a human-guided, LLM-assisted synthetic dataset of 500 short Bengali theatre records that expands to 1,500 retrieval documents. Dataset diagnostics confirm consistent identifiers and valid lighting fields while also revealing substantial dialogue repetition. A paired camera-ready evaluation compares single-combined and full multi-view retrieval under matched settings. The source code, dataset, and evaluation materials are publicly available.
summary_zh: 戏剧制作需协调对白、走位及灯光等多重约束，传统单库检索难以精准满足多维度需求。
提出ThetreStageAI框架，按场景、走位和灯光分视图检索，结合BGE-M3与Qdrant，由Gemini生成结构化JSON。
构建含500条记录的合成数据集，对比评估表明多视图检索优于单库混合检索，且代码与数据已开源。
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 12th IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Technologies and Engineering (IEEE iCOSTE 2026), Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, November 1-3, 2026

title: SIT-Eval: Situation-Based Interactive Turn-by-Turn Evaluation of Conversational Agents
title_zh: SIT-Eval：基于情境的对话智能体逐轮交互评估
abstract: The rapid proliferation of conversational AI agents necessitates evaluation methods that assess performance across diverse dialogue scenarios, utilizing multiple situational criteria, as appropriate behavior depends on context and encompasses various aspects. Existing dialogue benchmarks typically use static natural conversations, which underrepresent rare situations---a critical safety gap, as low-probability events become frequent failures at production scale. However, limited sample sizes force a choice: either maintain natural dialogues for realism or turn to adaptive situation sampling for comprehensive yet statistically reliable coverage. We introduce SIT-Eval, an adjustable framework for evaluating situation-based conversational agents. We formalize an agent's desired behavior as situational rules: if situation is P, follow rules Q. At each conversation turn, an LLM-interlocutor enacts a uniformly sampled situation. A context-aware LLM-judge leverages all conditionally applicable rules as criteria to evaluate the agent's reply for that situation. The judge is validated using human-verified synthetic golden dialogues. Benchmarking 8 LLMs on 1292 conversation turns reveals failure modes hidden by aggregate metrics: models with similar overall scores vary widely in their adherence to individual rules. All models struggle most with ambiguity clarification and Socratic questioning.
summary_zh: 现有对话基准多采用静态自然对话，难以覆盖罕见情境，导致生产规模下的低概率安全故障频发。
提出SIT-Eval框架，将智能体行为形式化为情境规则，由LLM对话者逐轮采样情境，LLM裁判依据规则评估回复。
对8个LLM的测试表明，总分相近的模型在单条规则遵守上差异显著，所有模型在澄清歧义和苏格拉底式提问上表现最差。

title: From Trajectories to Differentiated Skills: Cognitive Differentiation for Self-Improving Agents
title_zh: 从轨迹到分化技能：自改进Agent的认知分化
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents tackle complex tasks through reasoning and interaction with external environments. Agent skills provide persistent, transferable capabilities that guide task planning, inform contextual decisions, support tool use, and enable executable procedures. Yet existing skill-evolution methods largely organize knowledge around skill artifacts, overlooking the functional heterogeneity within individual skills and its implications for knowledge maintenance and use. Inspired by cognitive science, we propose Cognitive Differentiation in Skill Evolution (CDSE), which evolves a unified skill through four functionally distinct yet coordinated components: Meta, Experience, Tool, and Script. CDSE extracts evidence-grounded semantic gradients from successful and failed trajectories, consolidates them by functional role, and applies component-specific updates and validation with cross-component coordination and adaptive invocation. An analysis of 500 top-ranked skill packages shows that 96.8% contain knowledge spanning at least two functional roles. Across six benchmarks, three agent models, and two execution harnesses, CDSE achieves the highest scores in all 36 settings, improving over the Base agent by 7.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method in each setting by 2.6 points on average. Ablation studies further support the importance of functional differentiation and adaptive invocation.
summary_zh: 现有Agent技能演化方法忽视技能内部功能异质性，影响知识维护与使用。
提出CDSE方法，将技能分化为Meta等四类组件，从轨迹提取语义梯度并按角色更新验证。
实验表明CDSE在36项设置中均获最高分，较Base提升7.6%，验证了功能分化的重要性。

title: RL-Guided Temporal Localization for Dual-Channel Retrieval in Long-Horizon Agent Memory
title_zh: 长时序Agent记忆的双通道检索强化学习时间定位
abstract: Time-aware retrieval is crucial for long-horizon LLM agents to effectively leverage ever-growing long-term memory. Existing methods focus on lexical or semantic similarity, leading to target memories being crowded out by temporally mismatched yet semantically similar candidates. Even time-aware approaches inject temporal cues only during memory organization or answer generation, overlooking temporal constraints at the retrieval stage, where candidate selection occurs - the root cause of the displacement. Inspired by the temporal contiguity effect in human episodic memory, we propose TIDER (Temporal Interval-driven Dual-channel Evidence Retrieval), a time-aware agentic retrieval framework. Central to TIDER is a reinforcement learning (RL)-trained temporal interval locator that infers the temporal windows in which the evidence lies. RL optimizes window localization as a discrete, non-differentiable retrieval decision, using composite rewards to convert sparse answer supervision into fine-grained retrieval feedback. These temporal windows first define the temporal retrieval channel; the retrieved candidates are then merged with results from the semantic channel and reranked by proximity to the windows. This temporal grounding enables TIDER to retrieve temporally aligned evidence that would otherwise be drowned out by the volume of semantically similar yet temporally mismatched memories. With a lightweight 1.7B locator, TIDER achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on both long-horizon memory benchmarks - 61.52% on LifeBench (+8.82%) and 78.96% on LoCoMo (+3.66%) - which indicates that temporal cues are crucial for pinpointing target evidence amid a vast pool of semantically similar historical events in long-term daily-life memory.
summary_zh: 长时序LLM agent检索时，目标记忆易被语义相似但时间错位的候选淹没，现有方法未在检索阶段施加时间约束。
提出TIDER框架，用RL训练时间区间定位器推断证据时间窗，将稀疏监督转化为细粒度检索反馈。
时间窗定义时间检索通道，其结果与语义通道融合并重排，在两个基准上达到SOTA，证明时间线索对定位证据至关重要。

title: Enhancing RAG-based Medical VQA with Gated Multimodal Representations
title_zh: 基于门控多模态表示增强医学RAG视觉问答
abstract: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) have shown strong performance in Medical Visual Question Answering (MVQA), yet they may still produce factually inconsistent responses. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can mitigate this issue by incorporating external clinical evidence; however, retrieval is often guided by a single modality, potentially overlooking the joint semantics of medical images and clinical questions. We introduce a multimodal RAG framework that learns a joint query representation through a Gated Multimodal Unit, enabling evidence retrieval to leverage information from both modalities while keeping the underlying Med-LVLM frozen. We evaluate the proposed approach on benchmark datasets. Results show that the multimodal query representation consistently outperforms a reference Med-LVLM and remains competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Our findings demonstrate the potential of multimodal query representations for more effective evidence retrieval in Medical VQA.
summary_zh: 现有Med-LVLMs在MVQA中易产生事实不一致，且RAG常依赖单模态检索，忽略图文联合语义。
提出多模态RAG框架，通过门控多模态单元学习联合查询表示，在冻结底层模型下实现双模态检索。
实验表明该多模态查询表示持续优于参考Med-LVLM，且与SOTA方法保持竞争力，提升了证据检索效果。

title: Darwin-Claw: Environment-Adaptive Experience Consolidation for Recursively Self-Evolving Agents
title_zh: Darwin-Claw：面向递归自演化Agent的环境自适应经验巩固框架
abstract: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across complex tasks, they predominantly operate in isolated sessions, lacking the ability to continually learn from historical interactions or adapt to user-specific environments. Existing self-evolution paradigms often indiscriminately inject raw interaction trajectories into memory or skill modules, leading to obscured behavioral patterns and compromised update controllability. Furthermore, as foundational LLM reasoning improves, the bottleneck for agentic evolution shifts from accumulating generic knowledge to effectively managing situational experience. To address this, we propose Darwin-Claw, an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework that systematically distills episodic experiences to drive the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory. Theoretically grounded in an iterative agent-actor and evolver-critic co-adaptation, Darwin-Claw introduces a Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System that extracts fine-grained error attributions and generalizes them into dynamically updated prototype vectors. This structured situational experience serves as interaction patches for context-sensitive perception and explicit optimization signals for skill refinement. Practically, Darwin-Claw is a readily deployable, automated framework compatible with mainstream agent systems without requiring manual curation. Extensive experiments on WildClawBench demonstrate that Darwin-Claw yields substantial performance improvements, establishing a controllable and stable pathway for the continual, user-centric adaptation of autonomous agents in real-world ecosystems.
summary_zh: 现有LLM agent无法持续学习历史交互并适应特定环境，且自演化易盲目注入原始轨迹导致模式模糊与失控。
提出Darwin-Claw框架，通过分层经验巩固系统提取细粒度错误归因，泛化为动态原型向量以驱动演化。
该框架无需人工干预即可部署，实验表明其能提供可控稳定路径，显著提升agent在真实环境中的适应性能。

title: SkillBrowser: Selective Skill Exposure for Scalable Skill-Using Agents
title_zh: SkillBrowser：面向可扩展技能使用代理的选择性技能暴露
abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on skills to extend their capabilities in complex tasks. However, scalable skill use requires Selective Skill Exposure (SSE): providing relevant procedural content when needed while avoiding unnecessary exposure that may disrupt reasoning. Existing paradigms fall short in complementary ways. Progressive disclosure exposes metadata for a growing skill library, introducing context pollution; retrieval limits catalog exposure, but static retrieval from the initial task query may be misaligned with capability needs that emerge during reasoning and may still inject unnecessary skills. We propose SkillBrowser, a Meta-Skill-managed framework that enables an agent to identify current capability needs, formulate targeted queries, and selectively load skills on demand. Across six SRA-Bench subsets and five LLMs, SkillBrowser improves aggregate accuracy over static retrieval and LLM-based selection, including multi-step tool use, and mitigates accuracy degradation on already-solvable instances. Benefits remain model- and task-dependent, with under-invocation of useful skills and additional latency as key limitations. These results demonstrate the viability of Meta-Skill-managed SSE for scalable skill repositories.
summary_zh: LLM代理依赖技能扩展能力，但现有技能暴露方式易导致上下文污染或与推理中动态需求失准。
提出SkillBrowser框架，利用元技能管理让代理识别当前能力需求，按需定向查询并选择性加载技能。
实验表明该方法提升了整体准确率并缓解了性能退化，验证了元技能管理的SSE在可扩展技能库中的可行性。
comment: 23 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026

title: Embodiment-Aware Planning for Heterogeneous Bimanual Manipulation
title_zh: 面向异构双臂操作的具身感知规划
abstract: Many manipulation tasks that are effortless for dexterous human hands remain challenging for robotic systems equipped with simple, task-specialized grippers. Industrial platforms commonly rely on end-effectors such as suction cups or parallel-jaw grippers, yet no single mode can reliably satisfy the diverse constraints encountered across different phases of complex manipulation tasks, including pickup, reorientation, insertion, and constrained placement. In this work, we investigate whether complementary simple grippers within a heterogeneous bimanual setup can collectively realize tasks that exceed the capability of any individual gripper alone. Given a single human demonstration specifying the desired object motion, we formulate embodiment-aware execution as a finite-horizon optimization over arm-trajectory assignments. At each segment, the planner determines whether single-arm manipulation or a coordinated dual arm handover is required, jointly reasoning over heterogeneous grasp feasibility, motion constraints, manipulability, and cross-gripper compatibility. Exploiting this formulation, we compute globally consistent assignments with explicit switching regularization. Experiments on a dual Franka FR3 platform equipped with suction and parallel-jaw grippers demonstrate improved feasibility and reliability in tasks that are infeasible under single-gripper execution.
summary_zh: 单一简单夹爪难以满足复杂操作多阶段的多样约束，需探索异构双臂互补能否突破单夹爪能力极限。
给定单次人类演示，将具身感知执行建模为有限时域的臂轨迹分配优化问题，联合推理抓取可行性与运动约束等。
在双臂Franka平台上实验表明，该方法通过单双臂切换与交接，提升了单夹爪无法执行任务的可行性与可靠性。
comment: Please find the project website here: https://sukhvansh2004.github.io/Bimanual-Manipulation/

title: Reason-guided Human Reward Modeling for Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 基于偏好强化学习的推理引导人类奖励建模
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies optimized for task rewards may produce behaviors that are efficient but misaligned with human expectations, safety preferences, or intent. This paper presents a reason-guided preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) framework that learns a human reward model from trajectory-level feedback. In addition to preference labels, the framework incorporates reason tags explaining why a behavior is preferred, enabling the learned reward to capture both human choices and their underlying rationale. Compared with preference-only reward learning, the reason-guided formulation provides additional supervision for learning human-aligned rewards and improves the interpretability of the resulting policy. The learned human reward is combined with the environment reward during policy optimization, allowing the agent to improve task performance while producing more interpretable, human- aligned, and preference-sensitive behavior
summary_zh: 优化任务奖励的RL策略易与人类安全偏好失配，需引入人类反馈对齐行为。
提出推理引导的PbRL框架，利用轨迹偏好标签及解释原因标签共同监督奖励模型学习。
结合环境奖励优化策略，使智能体在提升任务性能的同时产生更可解释且人类对齐的行为。

title: ConvexLLM: Scaling Convex-Hull Speech Interfaces to General-Purpose Audio Intelligence
title_zh: ConvexLLM：将凸包语音接口扩展至通用音频智能
abstract: Speech and audio language models connect continuous acoustic representations to decoders pretrained primarily on text data. Most such models use MLP or Q-Former interfaces to map acoustic features into the decoder's input space, requiring the decoder to learn how to interpret the resulting representations. We investigate whether grounding these representations in the decoder's existing text embeddings can help it use acoustic information while better preserving its pretrained text capabilities. We present ConvexLLM, a general-purpose speech and audio language model whose C-Gate interface represents audio as continuous convex combinations of frozen text embeddings. ConvexLLM achieves an eleven-task VoiceBench aggregate of 75.36, the highest among the open-weight models we compare, and an MMAU Test-mini accuracy of 62.50%. Its largest margins over the baselines are on spoken knowledge and reasoning tasks, while the strongest baselines are more accurate on audio understanding and transcription. In a comparison with a 2B-parameter decoder, C-Gate achieves higher aggregate spoken-language performance than MLP and Q-Former interfaces, with text-task performance close to MLP and task-dependent tradeoffs in transcription and audio understanding. These results support convex combinations of text embeddings as a viable interface for general-purpose speech and audio language models.
summary_zh: 现有语音模型接口需解码器学习理解声学表示，易损害预训练文本能力。
提出ConvexLLM，其C-Gate接口将音频表示为冻结文本嵌入的连续凸组合。
该方法在11项语音任务上达开源最优，在知识与推理任务上优势显著，验证了凸组合接口的有效性。

title: From Billion-Scale to Million-Scale Language Models: Operational Capabilities for Embedded Post-Exploitation
title_zh: 从十亿到百万参数语言模型：内网渗透后的操作能力评估
abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for resource-constrained environments due to their low computational footprint. These characteristics also make them candidates for future autonomous malware, where connectivity, latency, privacy, or operational constraints may preclude cloud-based inference. Yet the ability of ultra-compact models to support malware during post-exploitation remains poorly understood. We systematically evaluate seven open-source SLMs (20M-1.5B parameters) on two post-exploitation code-generation tasks: Directory Enumeration and Backdoor Generation. We compare Python (high-resource) and Lua (low-resource) across prompting strategies, task formulations, iterative reasoning, grammar-constrained decoding, and execution-feedback loops. Results show that offensive code-generation capabilities do not increase linearly with model size. Successful execution depends on the interaction of model capacity, task formulation, and prompting strategy, with task formulation exerting a greater influence than prompt engineering alone. Algorithmic formulation combined with few-shot prompting enables Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B to reach Pass@5 of 100% in both Python and Lua for Directory Enumeration, 100% in Python for Backdoor Generation, and 99.2% in Lua. Although the evaluated models remain too computationally demanding for widespread deployment in contemporary malware, rapid progress in compact models may reduce this barrier. These findings help anticipate AI-assisted malware and inform future countermeasures.
summary_zh: 超紧凑语言模型用于恶意软件后渗透代码生成的能力尚不明确，需系统评估其在此场景下的实用性。
在目录枚举和后门生成任务上，对比不同提示策略与解码方法，评估7个开源SLM的代码生成表现。
攻击代码生成能力与模型规模非线性相关，任务构建比提示工程影响更大；当前模型算力需求仍阻碍其广泛部署。

title: Trapped in Your Story: Evaluating Narrative-Induced Sycophancy in Large Language Models
title_zh: 评估大语言模型中叙事诱导的谄媚行为
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are known to exhibit sycophancy by adjusting their responses toward users' expressed views. However, real users often justify their opinions through reasons, personal experiences, causal explanations, and broader narratives, raising the question of whether such narratives can further steer model judgments. We construct a controlled benchmark of 500 debatable questions across ten domains, where the user stance is held fixed while its justification is systematically varied without introducing new task-relevant evidence. Each question is instantiated under 11 matched conditions: one neutral baseline and five mirrored narrative levels for each of two opposing positions, yielding 5,500 evaluation instances. We evaluate seven LLMs and observe substantial differences in narrative-induced agreement. The effect is not monotonic with narrative elaboration: personal experience can reduce agreement, whereas causal framing and worldview-based synthesis increase it. Controlled GPT-5.1 ablations further show that causal framing produces the strongest positive effect, while claim-preserving bullet presentation also increases agreement over paragraph form. These findings suggest that sycophancy is shaped not only by user stance, but also by how supporting explanations are structured and presented.
summary_zh: 现有研究未探究用户叙事理由是否会进一步影响LLM的谄媚行为，故构建含500个争议问题及11种匹配条件的受控基准进行评估。
在7个LLM上的评估表明，叙事诱导的同意效应非单调：个人经历会降低同意率，而因果框架和世界观综合则增加同意率。
GPT-4o消融实验证实因果框架产生最强正向效应，要点列表比段落形式更易获模型同意，揭示解释结构影响谄媚。

title: Perceive, Solve, Reason: Progressive Capability Formation in Time Series-LLMs
title_zh: 时序大模型的渐进式能力形成：感知、求解与推理
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can now perceive, describe, and reason about images and audio, yet time series understanding remains underestimated: most work uses LLMs as forecasters and classifiers, reasoning studies are few and narrow, and no suite trains and evaluates the full range of capabilities. In this paper, we build the first such suite, with 337K training and 44K evaluation samples across three progressive capabilities, Perceive, Solve, and Reason, and use it to ask how time series should enter an LLM that must master all three, and in what order. We find that a dedicated encoder is essential: with one, a 4B model surpasses GPT-4o on every perception attribute we test, whereas textualizing the series costs 8--10 points in reasoning accuracy. The capabilities then build on one another: learning them in order beats mixing the same data and rivals reasoning-only training with over three times the reasoning data, but only when an encoder is used. Analyses further reveal that capabilities are transferred through distinct network depths rather than simply stacked, and that a stage converged on its own benchmark is not necessarily ready for the next. Distilled into a simple recipe, these findings yield 4B TS-LLMs that, without any target-domain data, outperform four recent 7B TS-LLMs on seven of eight out-of-domain metrics, by up to 11 points. We therefore advocate treating time series as a first-class modality for LLMs, read through dedicated encoders and taught to perceive before they reason.
summary_zh: 现有TS-LLM多局限于预测分类，缺乏对感知到推理全能力的训练评估，本文构建首个含337K训练与44K评估样本的渐进式能力套件。
发现专用编码器至关重要：配备后4B模型感知超GPT-4o，文本化致推理降8-10点；按序学习优于混合，媲美3倍数据纯推理训练。
能力通过网络不同深度迁移而非简单堆叠；据此方案训练的4B模型在8项域外指标中7项超越近期7B模型，主张时序应为一等模态。

title: MLOps-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Production ML Engineering in Real Repositories
title_zh: MLOps-Bench：基于真实代码库的生产级ML工程智能体基准
abstract: AI agents are increasingly expected to modify and maintain machine-learning systems in production, yet existing benchmarks primarily evaluate either competition-style ML experimentation or generic repository issue resolution. We introduce MLOps-Bench, a repository-grounded benchmark for production ML engineering. Unlike prior ML-agent benchmarks, MLOps-Bench evaluates executable lifecycle changes inside real ML repositories, spanning data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, model serving, monitoring, CI/CD and governance, and end-to-end integration. Each task is grounded in repository evidence and includes a natural-language requirement, oracle patch, plausible buggy baseline, fail-to-pass tests, pass-to-pass tests, and provenance metadata. The benchmark contains 212 validated tasks from 31 public ML repositories, with 636 fail-to-pass tests and 856 pass-to-pass tests. We evaluate six agents and find that the best system solves 31.2% of tasks while passing 68.7% of tests, showing that current agents often make partial progress but still fail production-relevant behavioral requirements. MLOps-Bench shifts agent evaluation beyond model building and issue fixing toward repository-native MLOps work where correctness depends on lifecycle reasoning, behavioral robustness, and preservation of existing system behavior.
summary_zh: 现有基准多关注竞赛式ML或通用问题修复，缺乏对生产级ML系统维护的评估，故提出MLOps-Bench。
该基准基于31个真实ML代码库构建212项任务，涵盖数据管道、模型服务、CI/CD等全生命周期变更，并配备测试与元数据。
评估6个智能体发现最佳系统仅解决31.2%任务，表明当前智能体难以满足生产级行为要求，推动评估向MLOps工作转移。

title: MuninAI: A Self-Hosted Agentic Framework for Independent Research Groups
title_zh: MuninAI：面向独立研究组的自托管智能体框架
abstract: Research groups that want a language model grounded in their own literature face a choice between hosted services that receive their unpublished work and self-hosted deployments that keep the data local but give the model no access to the corpus. Munin is an open-source framework for a self-hosted scientific assistant that indexes a group's corpus and its citation graph, and wraps whichever open-weight model the group can serve in an agent harness with specialised reading, search, and computation tools. We claim that the harness, rather than the specific model, is what makes the system useful on domain literature, and we ship the evaluation suite that tests this claim with the software. On 199 paired literature questions, the harness more than doubles the accuracy of the base model, from 0.387 to 0.874 (+0.487, 95% CI [0.407, 0.568]), while naive retrieve-then-answer scores below the unaided model on every backbone tested. Under the harness, roughly twice as many answer claims trace to a passage the model read itself as with fixed top-5 retrieval. When the source paper for a question is removed from the corpus, the system abstains on about nine in ten of the questions it had answered correctly on the Qwen backbones and eight in ten on gpt-oss-20b, and it produces no fabricated local citation across 300 fabricated references. The pattern holds on three backbones from two developers, including a 20-billion-parameter model that runs on a single consumer-grade GPU. With all outbound network access disabled, both Qwen backbones still exceed the published PaperQA2 accuracy. The evaluation suite runs as a single command, so an adopting group can re-run it on its own corpus and model.
summary_zh: 研究组需LLM基于自有文献，但托管服务泄露数据，自托管无法访问语料。MuninAI提供自托管框架，索引语料及引用图，为开源模型配备专用工具。
系统效用源于智能体工具而非特定模型。在199对文献问题中，该框架使基础模型准确率从0.387翻倍至0.874，而朴素RAG反而降低准确率。
系统具备高可靠性与可复现性：移除源文献时高比例弃答且无伪造引用；断网下Qwen仍超PaperQA2；评估套件支持用户一键复测。
comment: 37 pages, 3 figures, 20 tables. Code, evaluation suite and scorecards: https://github.com/elgetilab/munin (archived release v1.0.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23191404)

title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
title_zh: HexaShell：探索VLM Agent作为机器人编程Agent的极限
abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.
summary_zh: 问题：VLM Agent控制机器人执行操作任务时能达到何种极限及瓶颈。方法：构建极简系统HexaShell，将Agent命令转为机器人运动。结论：在RoboDojo上达到SOTA，发现瓶颈在于接触操作而非推理。
问题：Agent如何从失败中学习并积累经验。方法：失败后读取日志定位原因，编写或修复工具代码，将所学保留为代码。结论：Agent能像修复失败测试般持续积累可复用的操作工具。
问题：如何仅依赖视觉观测实现空间定位。方法：利用相机标定与多视图几何，通过射线相交或射线与已知平面相交进行三角测量。结论：无需额外感知，仅凭RGB相机与几何计算即可实现物体与夹爪的相对定位。

title: QD-Rec: Open-Ended Evolution of Recommendations via Quality-Diversity
abstract: Open-ended search combined with foundation models has produced advances such as faster algorithms, new results on open mathematical problems, and self-improving agents. We extend this paradigm to recommendation for decision-making, focusing on decisions where the set of possible choices is fixed but the reasons for choosing them are not. In high-stakes decisions, e.g., which company to acquire or which customer to target, comparing diverse, well-reasoned options can be more useful than a single ranked list. We formalize open-ended recommendation as building a diverse, high-quality set of recommendations, each an item together with a hypothesis, a natural-language reason why the item fits the needs of a decision maker. We propose QD-Rec, a quality--diversity method that selects items with a contextual bandit and generates hypotheses with a foundation model from earlier ones kept in an archive as stepping stones. A new recommendation enters the archive if it is novel or better than its nearest neighbor. Across M&A, customer targeting, and paper and book recommendation, QD-Rec gives the highest mean quality and builds the largest archive in most settings.

title: S-GAP: Stealthy Graph Attack Primitives for Graph Large Language Models
abstract: Graph Large Language Models (GraphLLMs) enable powerful semantic understanding and reasoning over Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs), while their semantic reasoning may exhibit vulnerabilities to perturbations in node text and graph structure under adversarial attack evaluation. Existing attacks typically construct textual and structural perturbations in separate stages guided by distinct realization intents. However, this separation results in attack-intent fragmentation, causing semantic incoherence between the two perturbation types, thereby undermining attack stealth and making them easier for GraphLLMs to identify and disregard, ultimately weakening attack effectiveness. To avoid attack-intent fragmentation, we propose the Graph Attack Primitive (GAP), an atomic semantic representation that unifies textual and structural perturbations under a coherent attack intent. By carefully calibrating the semantic composition of a GAP, we can achieve strong attack effectiveness while maintaining sufficient attack stealth. Furthermore, we introduce S-GAP (Stealthy GAP), a multi-agent framework that iteratively refines the semantic content of the GAP. The framework unifies GAP planning and realization and continuously refines this process through surrogate evaluation and textual feedback. Extensive experiments across four datasets, three GraphLLMs, and two attack settings show that S-GAP improves ASR over the strongest baselines by 7.02% on average while producing more relationally plausible perturbations, exposing critical vulnerabilities in current GraphLLMs and motivating more robust defenses.

title: GatewayBench: Unified Capability and Security Evaluation Platform for MCP Gateways
abstract: AI agents have increasingly interacted with external environments by invoking tools, with Model Context Protocol (MCP) emerging as a standard interface for connecting agents to heterogeneous tools and services. As organizations deploy agents at scale, MCP gateways have become a critical middleware layer for aggregating, governing, and shaping the tool surface exposed to agents. Despite the growing importance of MCP gateways in agentic systems, no prior work has systematically studied how gateway design affects agent capability, efficiency, and security. To address this gap, we introduce GatewayBench, the first unified evaluation framework and benchmark for MCP gateways. We characterize gateway architectures into two major paradigms: flattened gateways and hierarchical gateways. GatewayBench comprises 524 tasks across six domains, together with a pool of 11,118 real-world tools from 251 authentic MCP servers. To emulate large-scale deployments, we systematically inject task-irrelevant tools sampled from this pool into each agent environment, enabling controlled evaluation as the accessible tool surface scales. Based on GatewayBench, we conduct extensive experiments across seven widely deployed MCP gateways and diverse agent configurations, covering both benign and adversarial tasks. Our results reveal substantial differences across gateway designs in task completion, tool-use efficiency, and resilience to attacks, and further demonstrate that these effects interact strongly with the underlying model and agent harness. These findings highlight the MCP gateway as a consequential yet underexplored component of the agentic AI stack. By enabling controlled evaluation of gateway architectures under realistic tool ecosystems, GatewayBench provides both practical guidance for MCP gateway design and a rigorous testbed for developing more capable, efficient, and secure agentic systems.

title: ScoutRoute: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Routing Using Internal Language Model Signals
abstract: Efficient expert routing is a fundamental challenge in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) systems, particularly for heterogeneous collections of independently trained Large Language Mod els (LLMs). Existing routing approaches typically rely on jointly trained gating networks, prompt-based predictors, or computationally expensive multi-model inference, limiting their flexibility and efficiency. This paper presents ScoutRoute, a lightweight post-hoc routing framework that predicts expert competence using internal language model signals extracted from a single forward pass through an inexpensive scout model. Hidden-state representations are used to estimate cross-model competence through lightweight logistic probes, while logit-derived confidence measures are incorporated within a domain-aware routing strategy for efficient expert selec tion without modifying the underlying language models. ScoutRoute isevaluatedon fiveopen-weightlanguagemodels across fourbenchmark datasets covering mathematical reasoning, code generation, commonsense reasoning, and multidis ciplinary knowledge. Experimental results show that ScoutRoute consistently outperforms individual routing signals while requiring only a single scout-model inference. The proposed competence probes also achieve superior calibration compared with conventional confidence measures, demonstrating that internal language model representations provide transferable information for accurate and efficient expert routing across heterogeneous language models
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Published in Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, 2026
journal_ref: Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, vol. 1, no. 1, 2026

title: Residual Stochastic Concept Bottleneck Models
abstract: Concept-based models (CMs) learn human-interpretable intermediate representations that enable users to understand the model's reasoning and steer its predictions through test-time concept interventions. However, in realistic settings, their performance can be limited by concept incompleteness, where the training concepts fail to capture all task-relevant information. Adding an unconstrained residual pathway to the model's predictive process can overcome the consequences of incompleteness. However, this introduces an inscrutable, leak-prone prediction pathway that may weaken concept interventions, as these often leave residual variables unchanged. To address this limitation, we introduce Residual Stochastic Concept Bottleneck Models (Res-SCBMs), a family of concept-based models that jointly model concept and residual variables through a multivariate Gaussian distribution. Res-SCBMs learn a covariance structure that explicitly captures dependencies between the known concepts and learnt residual variables, allowing interventions to propagate to statistically dependent residual variables through Gaussian conditioning. This extends the intervention capabilities of previous CMs without requiring concept completeness during training. Our results show that, across multiple concept-incomplete benchmarks, Res-SCBMs improve predictive performance over competing baselines while retaining effective test-time concept interventions.

title: GeoReason: Bridging Logical Reasoning and Spatial Fidelity in Remote Sensing Segmentation
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced instruction-driven perception through the "Embedding-as-Mask" paradigm. However, extending this capability to Remote Sensing (RS) reasoning segmentation remains exceptionally challenging under cluttered geographical contexts and extreme scale variations, often leading to Spatial Fidelity Degradation and Target Misidentification. We identify a critical yet underexplored bottleneck: the sequential alienation of the segmentation token [SEG] from its initial visual grounding within the autoregressive generation paradigm. Produced only at the end of long reasoning chains, [SEG] relies on visual evidence that has been progressively diluted by linguistic abstraction and autoregressive noise. This information decay is particularly catastrophic for RS targets with minuscule pixel footprints, where even marginal fidelity loss leads to localization failure. To address these bottlenecks, we propose GeoReason, a novel framework designed to fortify logical deduction and preserve spatial integrity. First, we introduce an Anticipatory Prior mechanism that injects the [SEG] token directly into the initial user query, shifting it from a terminal output to a primary condition. This paradigm shift transforms the token into a persistent spatial anchor, preventing information decay during long-form linguistic inference. Second, we enhance visual reasoning via a Location-aware Chain-of-Thought (CoT) that enforces coarse-to-fine localization using bounding boxes, coupled with a Latent Patch-to-Token Alignment (PTA) Loss that explicitly aligns the latent segmentation token with physical RS textures.
