We report the ablations behind the recipe and an evaluation protocol built on short fixed SFT runs, since base-model proxy metrics did not correlate reliably with post-training results.
summary_zh: 预训练缺乏长上下文与agent交互，长SFT损害RL训练能力，需在两者间引入中间训练阶段。
在256K上下文下，使用海量自然软件工程数据与少量agent轨迹对基础模型进行中间训练。
该方案显著提升模型在SWE-bench等基准的得分与跨agent框架鲁棒性，且不损害后续RL训练。

title: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
title_zh: 基于因果引导的问答检索智能体CARA
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.
summary_zh: 现有智能体检索依赖文本相似度，难以识别对回答问题有因果贡献的证据。
提出无训练的CARA智能体，通过后果性与必要性评估证据的因果相关性，结合路径一致性引导图探索。
实验表明CARA持续优于现有检索器，以更少检索操作提升检索性能及下游问答质量与忠实度。

title: Close Enough is Nowhere Near: Fidelity-Consumability Decoupling in KV Caches
title_zh: KV缓存的保真度与可用性解耦：近似替代不可行
abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems communicate in text, which is lossy and wasteful: the sender throws away the reading it already did. A growing literature instead transmits the KV cache, the natural carrier of that reading. We study the most appealing form of the idea: both models stay frozen and the sender's cache is substituted for the reader's with nothing trained. It does not work, and the obstruction belongs to the reader. A frozen transformer reads only caches close to the one it would have written itself, a region we call its tolerable set. We show that geometric similarity to that cache does not predict whether the reader can use it, and the failure is not gradual, so a more faithful substitute is not the remedy it appears to be. We explain this phenomenon with competitive attention. Experimentally, we test eight diverse substitution methods against two measured anchors: an uninformative cache baseline and the reader's own accuracy from having read the passage. All sit at the baseline. That turns a long tail of separate negative results into one outcome with a stated condition for overturning it. A different design does work: if the reader keeps its own cache and attends over the sender's as extra context, adapting only its queries, it beats its own baseline, and also clears the baseline with eight senders pooled where undirected attention over the same union falls below it. We offer this as a characterization on one probe, not a leaderboard claim. Our central contribution is a redirection: pursuing faithful substitute caches is the wrong target; adding a cache to what the reader already has is the promising one.
summary_zh: 多智能体LLM系统直接传输文本存在信息损失与浪费，传输KV缓存作为替代方案面临冻结模型间缓存不可用的挑战。
冻结Transformer仅能读取自身生成的缓存，几何相似度无法预测可用性且失败非渐进，竞争注意力机制解释了此现象。
直接替换发送方缓存完全失效，而将发送方缓存作为额外上下文供接收方注意力查询则有效，证明追求忠实替代是错误方向。

title: GRID-Planner: Graph-Structured Relational Reward Shaping for Diffusion Planning
title_zh: GRID-Planner：面向扩散规划的图结构关系奖励塑造
abstract: Autonomous driving planning requires selecting trajectories that remain safe, rule-compliant, and comfortable under complex multi-agent interactions, yet robust closed-loop decision making in planning-critical scenes remains challenging. Existing diffusion- and RL-based planners often rely on generic rewards and use relational structure mainly for representation, limiting how planning-critical rollouts shape policy improvement. We present GRID-Planner, a graph--reward integrated diffusion planning framework that aligns generative planning with structured relational signals. Specifically, GRID-Planner combines graph-aware importance weighting, a time-indexed relational reward surrogate, and an advantage-weighted diffusion objective with on-policy self-distillation, forming a rollout-return-advantage-update loop without explicit likelihoods. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan show that, compared with the diffusion-only baseline, GRID-Planner reduces collision rate, lane deviation, and jerk by 35.8\%, 60.8\%, and 27.4\%, respectively, and improves the planning score by 3.4\%. Project website: https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶规划在复杂交互下难以实现鲁棒的闭环决策，现有基于扩散和RL的规划器未能充分利用关系结构指导策略改进。
提出GRID-Planner框架，结合图感知重要性加权、时间索引关系奖励代理与优势加权扩散目标，构建无显式似然的闭环更新。
在nuPlan等基准上，相比纯扩散基线，碰撞率、车道偏差和急动度分别降低35.8%、60.8%和27.4%，规划得分提升3.4%。

title: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
title_zh: Jianmu-Q：用AI Agent连接量子场论与量子硬件
abstract: Quantum computing offers a promising approach to non-perturbative simulations of quantum field theories, particularly for real-time dynamics and systems affected by the sign problem. Yet translating continuum field theories into quantum computations remains a challenging interdisciplinary task. Here we introduce \texttt{Jianmu-Q}, a multi-agent framework that transforms natural-language descriptions of quantum field theories into quantum simulation workflows. Specialized agents handle theoretical formulation, lattice discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit design, while physical consistency checks and independent numerical calculations provide validation throughout the workflow. We benchmark the framework on three field theories of increasing complexity: the $(1+1)$-dimensional Nambu--Jona-Lasinio and Schwinger models, and a $(2+1)$-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge theory. Across these systems, noiseless quantum-circuit simulations converge toward independent exact-diagonalization and tensor-network results, while selected circuits are executed on IBM quantum hardware, demonstrating an end-to-end, validation-guided approach to quantum simulation of field theories.
summary_zh: 将连续场论转化为量子计算是跨学科难题，本文提出多Agent框架Jianmu-Q，将场论自然语言描述转为量子模拟工作流。
该框架由专用Agent处理理论构建、格点离散化、量子比特映射与电路设计，并通过物理一致性检验和独立数值计算进行全程验证。
在三种场论基准测试中，无噪量子电路模拟收敛于独立精确结果，并在IBM量子硬件上运行，实现端到端验证引导的量子模拟。
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Jianmu-lab/Jianmu-Q

title: Defense Filters for Robust Learning of Partially Observed Dynamical Systems
title_zh: 部分观测动力系统的防御滤波鲁棒学习
abstract: Robust estimation of unknown system dynamics from partial observations under attack is a core challenge in learning for control, increasingly critical in multi-agent networks subject to adversarial data poisoning. Existing methods either require highly restrictive assumptions on the adversary or yield weak error bounds. In this paper, we consider identifying partially observed linear dynamical systems subject to adversarial attacks with an attack probability $p < 0.5$ at each time. We propose a defense-filtering framework in which a system designer leverages knowledge of the observation matrix to construct a defense filter satisfying full column rank and subspace separability conditions, which enables the evaluation of a single-attack scenario against observed data. Using this framework, we analyze the constrained $\ell_2$-norm estimator and establish finite-sample error bounds for recovering the Markov parameter matrix $G^*$. This is the first approach to provide provable system identification guarantees via a defense filter for partially observed systems subject to harsh attack environments where the attack probability approaches $0.5$.
summary_zh: 部分观测动力系统在对抗攻击下的鲁棒辨识缺乏有效方法，现有方法假设严苛或误差界限弱。
提出防御滤波框架，利用观测矩阵构造满足列满秩与子空间可分性条件的防御滤波器，以评估单攻击场景。
基于该框架分析约束l2范数估计器，首次在攻击概率逼近0.5的恶劣环境下，给出恢复Markov参数矩阵的有限样本误差保证。

title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Design-Aware Code Review in the Linux Kernel
title_zh: Linux内核中设计感知代码审查的基准与增强
abstract: Code review often requires reasoning beyond local correctness. In mature software systems, reviewers must recognize design trade-offs introduced by a proposed change, compare alternative solutions, and reason about their compatibility with project-specific constraints. We refer to this problem as design-aware code review. However, existing automated review approaches primarily focus on defects and correctness, while the design knowledge accumulated in historical review discussions remains difficult to reuse. To address these challenges, we present DesignLore, a knowledge-augmented approach that extracts design decisions from historical review discussions, organizes them into an adaptive design taxonomy, and reuses relevant historical knowledge to guide code review. We further construct DesignReviewBench, a benchmark derived from real patch-review histories for systematically evaluating design-aware code review. Our evaluation shows that design-aware review remains challenging for current coding agents, with the strongest baseline achieving an F1 of only 0.213 on design trade-off detection. In comparison, DesignLore achieves an F1 of 0.259, a 21.6% relative improvement, and consistently delivers gains across different agent systems and backbone. These results highlight the importance of design-aware review and demonstrate the potential of recovering and reusing historical design knowledge to support it.
summary_zh: 现有自动代码审查多关注局部正确性，难以复用历史审查中的设计知识，无法处理设计权衡问题。
提出DesignLore方法，从历史审查中提取设计决策构建自适应分类法，并复用相关知识指导审查。
构建DesignReviewBench基准，实验表明当前coding agent设计审查能力弱，DesignLore的F1相对提升21.6%。

title: CodeHealth Predicts the Token Cost of Agentic Code Review: A Pre-Registered Study of 465 Agent-Authored Pull Requests
title_zh: 代码健康度预测智能体代码审查的Token成本
abstract: Context: Organizations increasingly delegate code review to multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines billed per token. Low code quality raises human maintenance effort, but its effect on agent review cost has not been measured. Objective: We test whether baseline CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic review and fix beyond pull request (PR) footprint. Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository caps. A frozen five-agent review-and-fix pipeline processed every PR with three different LLMs. Per LLM, we fitted a mixed model of log tokens on CodeHealth and log PR footprint, with a repository random intercept. Results: For all three LLMs the CodeHealth coefficient was negative, with 95% CI excluding zero; each CodeHealth point was associated with 3.5% to 6.1% lower token cost. CodeHealth was unrelated to PR footprint, so PR size does not explain the association. Two of three registered smells predicted fix cost; batch fixing left median CodeHealth unchanged. Exploratory analyses located the association in the review stage, where agents iterated more on unhealthy code without writing more comments. Adjusting for the size of the scored files absorbed the association, which we interpret as mediation by file size. Conclusions: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability also predicts the inference cost of multi-agent review and fix. The effect is modest per point and not carried by PR size, so the refactoring case extends to agent-reviewed code when it changes structure and file size, not only the score. Data Availability: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22127920
summary_zh: 按Token计费的LLM智能体审查成本高昂，但代码质量对审查成本的影响尚未明确。
对465个智能体PR进行预注册观察研究，用冻结的五智能体流水线及三种LLM拟合混合模型。
代码健康度每增1点，Token成本降3.5%-6.1%，该效应由文件大小介导而非PR大小。

title: Learning Rewards in Strategic Games
title_zh: 策略博弈中的奖励学习
abstract: Understanding the objectives that drive agents' behavior is crucial in strategic environments, where multiple agents interact and adapt to one another. This challenge arises in domains such as cybersecurity, autonomous driving, and online markets, where agents' underlying incentives are typically unknown and must be inferred from their observed behavior. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a natural framework for this problem, but extending IRL to strategic multi-agent settings introduces a fundamental challenge: a reward that explains observed behavior does not necessarily induce optimal strategies when used for decision-making. In this work, we study this problem through the lens of \emph{strategic identifiability}, and show that learning from a fixed policy pair can be insufficient to strategically identify rewards, independent of the number of expert samples $K$. Motivated by this, we introduce an active IRL algorithm for two-player repeated Stackelberg games, in which the leader adaptively selects policies to elicit informative responses about the follower's reward. Combining maximum-likelihood estimation with experimental design, we derive finite-sample guarantees on the Stackelberg sub-optimality induced by the learned reward, matching up to polylogarithmic factors a new minimax learning rate of $K^{-1/2}$. Finally, we evaluate our approach in a realistic anti-poaching setting, demonstrating the benefits of active exploration for reward recovery and downstream strategic performance.
summary_zh: 在多智能体交互中推断未知奖励，但传统IRL学到的奖励用于决策时未必最优。
固定策略对不足以策略性识别奖励，因此提出针对两人重复Stackelberg博弈的主动IRL算法。
该算法结合最大似然估计与实验设计，实现了匹配极小极大率的学习保证，并在反盗猎场景中验证了其有效性。

title: CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness
title_zh: CoWorld Reasoner：基于演进视频世界模型驱动的智能体多模态推理
abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) advance, they are increasingly expected to perform spatiotemporal reasoning over motion, actions, and view changes beyond what the input images show. Video World Models (VWMs) provide a natural unified engine for visual imagination by generating task-relevant visual content as additional evidence. However, existing approaches typically invoke a VWM through fixed pipelines centered on a predefined form of visual imagination, such as novel-view synthesis. To support flexible visual imagination for diverse reasoning tasks, we introduce CoWorld Reasoner, an agentic framework that uses a VWM as a unified visual reasoning engine. Its Video World Model-Driven Harness exposes multiple visual operations through tools and uses skills to guide the VLM in deciding whether to imagine, selecting an operation, constructing a generation request, and interpreting the resulting visual evidence. We further introduce VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution, which jointly revises tools, skills, and execution code based on execution feedback while keeping both model weights fixed. Across seven benchmarks spanning spatial intelligence, temporal and causal reasoning, and perceptual reasoning, CoWorld Reasoner outperforms direct reasoning with the same VLM. The strongest variant improves on all seven benchmarks, including relative accuracy gains of 11.8% on MMSI and 13.0% on ERQA, and outperforms all five evolving baselines using the same backbone across five benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现有VLM缺乏时空推理能力，且现有VWM调用方式固定，本文提出CoWorld Reasoner智能体框架以支持灵活的视觉想象。
该框架通过工具暴露多种视觉操作，利用技能引导VLM决定是否想象、选择操作、构建请求并解释视觉证据。
引入VLM-VWM协同演进机制，基于执行反馈修正工具与代码；实验表明该框架在七个基准上超越直接推理，最高提升13.0%。

title: TEM: Temporal State Tracking Memory for Large Language Model Agents
title_zh: 面向大语言模型智能体的时序状态跟踪记忆
abstract: An agent's memory must remain useful as information changes across conversations. A new fact may replace an earlier value without making that value irrelevant to a later question. We present Temporal State Tracking Memory (TEM), a training-free framework for tracking these changes. TEM stores facts as versioned records linked to their sources. It retrieves relevant versions, places them in source order and labels historical records before passing the evidence to the answer model. Event memory and original dialogue turns provide details missing from structured facts. We evaluated TEM on 420 questions drawn from 600 sessions involving 60 personas. Across four open-weight models, key-entity hit rates reached 75.71-97.62% overall and 96.67-100.00% on the historical-residence subset. Adding historical labels to otherwise identical, source-ordered facts increased overall hit rates by 17.14-55.95 percentage points. The evidence was compact: 94-118 tokens per answer, or 48.75-56.73% less than session-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). A further evaluation on 1,540 LoCoMo questions tested hybrid memory under a fixed evidence budget. TEM exceeded session-aware RAG with both backbones; conservative score differences were 7.92 and 10.58 percentage points. The results support preserving fact versions and exposing their temporal status to the generator when answering questions about repeatedly updated information.
summary_zh: 智能体记忆需适应信息随对话更新，旧事实可能仍与后续问题相关，需解决事实版本跟踪问题。
提出无需训练的TEM框架，将事实存为带版本记录，按来源排序并标注历史状态后供模型使用。
TEM在多模型上关键实体命中率最高达97.62%，证据长度比RAG减少近半，验证了保留事实版本及时间状态的有效性。

title: SurgStreamer: proactive, request-driven monitoring of surgical video streams with structured state and a reusable reasoning layer
title_zh: SurgStreamer：基于结构化状态与可复用推理层的外科视频流主动监控
abstract: Surgical teams could benefit from assistants that watch the video for requested events, such as "tell me when the clip applier appears during Calot triangle dissection", and answer questions about what has already happened. We formalise this task as request-driven event detection with exact semantics and causal alert decisions, and present SurgStreamer. It separates procedure-specific perception, which maps the 1-FPS stream to a structured state over tools, actions and phases, from procedure-agnostic reasoning, which evaluates a formal monitoring condition over this state and an event memory, either with exact rules or with a small controller that addresses entities through pointers rather than names. We evaluate this monitoring core with gold conditions. On a pre-registered, sealed test set of 12 laparoscopic cholecystectomies, SurgStreamer reached a macro event-F1 of 0.598 over full procedures. On identical 75-s windows with only the window available to every method, it scored 0.677. The tested configurations of the streaming vision-language model OneStreamer-4B, including ones fine-tuned on SurgStreamer's state or on video with an adapted vision encoder, scored at most 0.540 (Holm-adjusted p <= 0.012). At three external centres, re-training only perception raised performance on held-out procedures from 0.239 to 0.470. On a new procedure, pituitary surgery, controller weights trained on cholecystectomy matched an in-domain controller on oracle state (0.947 vs 0.938). On predicted state they missed the pre-registered non-inferiority margin (-0.024 [-0.040, -0.008]) unless the alert thresholds were re-calibrated. The results support separating perception from reasoning and point to perception under distribution shift as the main limitation.
summary_zh: 外科团队需助手按请求监控视频事件并回答问题，本文将其形式化为具有精确语义的请求驱动事件检测任务。
提出SurgStreamer，将特定术式的感知映射为结构化状态，与通用推理层分离，推理层通过规则或小控制器评估监控条件。
实验表明该方法显著优于微调的VLM，感知与推理分离有效，但分布偏移下的感知误差是主要局限。

title: Anvil: Scaling Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Knowledge Recirculation
title_zh: Anvil：通过知识再循环扩展具身空间智能
abstract: Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that distinguish stage competence from error propagation. (3) Anvil-MOPD is a 9B student that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge through distillation from specialist teachers. Semantic-first-fault routing targets teacher supervision to the student's earliest decisive failure, while stage normalization controls the loss scale across native outputs of different lengths. We construct 5.8M source-grounded records spanning 160K images, reserving 580K spatial records for held-out evaluation and using the remaining 5.22M records for training. On average across seven public benchmarks, Anvil-MOPD outperforms Qwen3.5-9B and RynnBrain-8B by 9.29 and 11.03 percentage points, respectively, while reaching 80.67% on VABench-Point. Controlled studies support targeted coverage, selective transfer, and feedback-guided repair as complementary framework components.
summary_zh: 具身空间智能的联合训练常因跨阶段监督碎片化导致知识混淆，需统一框架解决。
提出Anvil框架，含数据飞轮Anvil-Gen、对齐监督与评估基准Anvil-Ben，及9B蒸馏模型Anvil-MOPD。
模型在七个公开基准上显著优于同量级模型，验证了覆盖、选择性迁移与反馈修复的有效性。

title: MedPAO-VL: Interpretable and Protocol-Compliant Agent for Structured Radiology Report Generation
title_zh: MedPAO-VL：生成结构化放射报告的可解释合规智能体
abstract: Despite the remarkable generalization capabilities of Large Language Models, generating clinically accurate and structured radiology reports from medical images remains a significant challenge. Current end-to-end approaches function as black boxes, prone to factual hallucinations and generating ungrounded findings. This lack of reliability and failure to adhere to domain-specific structuring protocols, fundamentally limits their clinical utility. We present MedPAO-VL, a multimodal agent that shifts the paradigm from monolithic generation to explainable, iterative, protocol-compliant structured report generation. Unlike deterministic models, our plan-act-observe loop functions as a goal-oriented agent: it first perceives the Chest X-Ray through an explainable vision module designed to capture inherent diagnostic uncertainty, then iteratively refines the generated report by observing semantic discrepancies and self-correcting its generation for better alignment with visually detected clinical findings. Evaluation of our framework demonstrates that this agentic reasoning improves clinical correctness and completeness, achieving an expert-rated accuracy score of 3.5/5 and a structural score of 4.3/5. By prioritizing pathology specific explainability and iterative refinement over opaque end-to-end mapping, MedPAO-VL offers a transparent and clinically viable alternative for automated structured radiology report generation.
summary_zh: 现有端到端模型生成放射报告易产生幻觉且不合规，缺乏临床可靠性。
提出MedPAO-VL多模态智能体，采用计划-行动-观察循环迭代修正报告。
该方法提升了临床正确性与完整性，准确度达3.5/5，结构评分4.3/5。
comment: The paper has been accepted at ECCV BISCUIT Workshop, 2026

title: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
title_zh: RSIFlow：基于演进元Agent的自适应自改进工作流
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex tasks, including code generation, tool use, and multi-hop question answering. Existing self-improvement methods enhance agent performance through model optimization, harness evolution, and executable artifact refinement, while recursive self-improvement (RSI) further extends optimization to the improvement mechanisms themselves. However, adapting self-improvement workflows to evolving performance bottlenecks while improving workflow orchestration through execution feedback remains a key challenge. We propose \textbf{RSIFlow}, a \textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{I}mprovement framework that integrates adaptive work\textbf{flow} orchestration with meta-agent capability evolution. RSIFlow diagnoses performance bottlenecks from task-agent trajectories and environmental feedback to dynamically select component-specific improvement workflows. The meta-agent then distills workflow outcomes into component-specific skills and cross-component principles, evolving its own harness to improve subsequent workflow orchestration. Experiments across six benchmarks and two backbone models show that RSIFlow achieves the SOTA average performance on all benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of adaptive workflow orchestration and meta-harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/1HUAN1/RSI-Flow.
summary_zh: 现有LLM自改进方法难以适应动态性能瓶颈并利用执行反馈优化工作流编排。
提出RSIFlow框架，通过诊断瓶颈动态选择改进工作流，元Agent提炼技能与原则以演进自身编排机制。
实验表明RSIFlow在六项基准上达到SOTA平均性能，消融实验验证了自适应编排与元机制演进的有效性。

title: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
title_zh: 在三维世界中学习思考与探索
abstract: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.
summary_zh: 现有VLM处理3D任务依赖多视角输入，本文将其转为agent在3D环境中主动交互探索。
采用轨迹监督微调结合强化学习，仅以答案正确性为奖励，让模型自主学习探索策略。
ACT3D在6个基准上平均准确率达53.2%，超越Gemini 3.6 Flash，且能自适应探索并泛化至未知域。

title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
title_zh: 从研究目标到科学闭环：基于物理学的智能体评估
abstract: Can AI agents organize scientific investigations that lead to well-supported conclusions? To evaluate this capability, we introduce PhysClosureBench, a benchmark of 50 expert-verified, goal-specified research tasks spanning strong-field, attosecond, and neighboring physics areas. Each task specifies the research objective and essential scientific constraints, while leaving the agent to organize the investigation and determine how to generate and validate the evidence needed to answer the question. A 20-criterion Atomic Score measures local scientific accomplishment, while Research Closure (RC0--RC4) assesses how fully the investigation resolves the specified research question based on whether its indispensable evidence requirements and applicable scope conditions are satisfied. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs, where Claude-Opus-5 achieves the highest mean Atomic Score (6.29/10) but reaches RC4 in only 32.7% of attempts. Across the benchmark, 36.2% of attempts scoring at least 8/10 still fall short of RC4, while all seven models reach RC4 on substantially fewer tasks in all three runs than in at least one. Case-level analysis further illustrates how misinterpretation of generated results and unresolved physical applicability limits can lead to incomplete closure. Together, these results reveal a persistent gap between AI agents' local scientific accomplishments and their ability to achieve complete research closure.
summary_zh: 为评估AI智能体能否得出有充分依据的科学结论，提出PhysClosureBench基准，包含50个专家验证的物理研究任务。
采用原子分数衡量局部科学成就，并定义研究闭环等级（RC0-RC4）评估任务解决完整度，对7个前沿LLM进行评测。
实验揭示智能体局部成就与实现完整研究闭环间存在持续差距，高局部分数常无法达成闭环，误读结果与适用性限制是主因。

title: DeciCAD: Harness-Grounded Learning of Action Policies for CAD Agents
title_zh: DeciCAD：面向CAD代理的基于线束的动作策略学习
abstract: Large Language Model agents operate through closed-loop action policies whose decision space is defined by an agent harness. We investigate how this operating space shapes agent behavior and policy learning in computer-aided design (CAD), a professional domain characterized by persistent state, geometric constraints, and long-horizon procedures. We instantiate this perspective in DeciCAD, a domain-native harness that exposes semantic CAD actions, decision-oriented observations, environment feedback, and persistent state transitions. Building on this harness, we develop a learning pipeline that extracts causal decision supervision from interaction trajectories and improves the policy through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and geometry-grounded online reinforcement learning (RL). Across four CAD benchmarks, DeciCAD achieves the best F1 and intersection over union (IoU) while reducing model-output tokens by 45--88% relative to a general-purpose coding harness. Under matched supervision, its SFT policy improves F1 from 0.6883 to 0.7437 and outperforms the coding policy; subsequent online RL further raises geometry availability from 66.5% to 73.5% and F1 to 0.7880. These results demonstrate that the decision space induced by a harness materially affects both agent execution and policy learning in CAD.
summary_zh: LLM代理在CAD领域的决策空间受限于代理线束，需探究该操作空间如何影响代理行为与策略学习。
提出DeciCAD线束暴露语义动作与状态反馈，并构建学习管线，利用轨迹的因果监督进行SFT与几何在线RL。
DeciCAD在四项基准上取得最佳F1与IoU，大幅减少输出词元；SFT与在线RL显著提升几何可用率与F1。

title: The Delegation Dilemma: Economies of Scale, Accountability, and Polycentric Governance
title_zh: 委托困境：规模经济、问责与多中心治理
abstract: Many collective-action systems are neither fully decentralized nor fully centralized: agents voluntarily organize into institutions that share organizational costs and delegate decisions to representatives. Delegation can reduce individual costs, but it also transfers control to representatives whose private objectives need not align with those of their constituents. We study this tension in a repeated game with endogenous delegation to self-interested centers. A simple reduced-form model yields a scale--accountability tradeoff: larger constituencies offer greater cost-sharing benefits to members, yet the marginal value to a center of retaining any one constituent decreases as group size grows. Consequently, the prospect of individual exit can sustain non-exploitative delegation only up to an endogenous accountable constituency size. Additionally, we identify parameter regions in which fully delegated, accountable governance, when feasible, must be polycentric. We investigate these predictions through simulations with large language model (LLM) agents. Across five matched pairs of 30-agent simulations, polycentric structures repeatedly emerge but remain fluid, exhibiting cycles of concentration, exploitation, exit, and re-formation. We further find that models of different capacity exhibit similar willingness to assume leadership but differ substantially in their exercise of authority, with Sol initiating exploitation more frequently than Luna in matched decision states.
summary_zh: 集体行动中委托代表可降低个体成本，但代表私利可能与成员冲突，需解决此委托困境。
构建重复博弈模型，发现规模与问责存在权衡：群体越大成本分摊越多，但代表问责性越弱。
LLM 代理仿真验证了多中心治理的必然性，并发现不同模型行使权力的方式存在显著差异。

title: Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures
title_zh: 将人类干预视为标签：定位、引导及编辑LLM Agent失败计算
abstract: When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at a definite residual-stream depth, with site and dose chosen on training data, and random directions under the same procedure flip at most one episode. Second, over-asking has two mechanistic signatures: in four families the model demonstrably knows the request is unambiguous (the belief is decodable, causally inert and orthogonal to the decision) and asks anyway; in the fifth, the rare over-asks track different world-representations. Third, steering gated on a probe readout removes most of the simulated oversight burden while legitimate questions survive (bootstrap 95% intervals exclude zero); a prompt instruction makes it worse. Fourth, consolidating the fix into the weights yields a map, not a rule: on one model a LoRA confined to the causal band passes every criterion fixed in advance while behavior cloning on identical data breaks retention; on three families the reverse holds; on the fifth the outcome crosses the boundary across seeds. A geometric rule written down in advance to predict the regime failed on two out-of-family tests; we report the failure and stop rather than fit a replacement.
summary_zh: LLM Agent失败时的人类干预常被丢弃，本文将其视为测量标签，指向内部出错计算，并在受控环境中研究过度提问失败。
利用干预标签学习因果方向，可在特定残差流深度翻转72-100%的过度提问，证明该决策具有因果可定位性。
基于探针的引导机制能消除多数模拟监督负担且保留合法提问；将修复整合为权重时，LoRA与行为克隆效果因模型而异。

title: ConStore: Search-Overlapped Prefetch and Co-Retrieval-Aware Content Storage for Disk-Based ANNS
title_zh: 面向磁盘ANNS的ConStore：搜索重叠预取与共检索感知存储
abstract: Disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) supports retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), search, recommendation, and advertising over corpora that exceed memory capacity. Existing ANNS research often focuses on vector search at small top-K, whereas industrial-scale applications require larger retrieval sets. Fetching the corresponding content from storage remains comparatively underexplored. Our profiling across million- to billion-vector corpora shows that, at large K, content fetch latency can match or exceed vector-search latency and cannot be ignored in end-to-end retrieval. We present ConStore, a content storage engine combining two complementary techniques to reduce end-to-end retrieval latency. Speculative Inline Content Prefetch (SICP) commonly abstracts graph-based and cluster-based ANNS as progressive SSD I/O that refines an in-flight candidate queue. It prefetches content for stable leading candidates under a bounded I/O budget, overlapping content reads with search without changing the final top-K results. Co-Retrieval-Pattern-Aware Grouping (RPAG) uses query logs to place frequently co-retrieved documents in contiguous segments. Workload-Adaptive Segment Reorganization (WASR) adapts this layout to workload shifts by selectively regrouping segments under a bounded rewrite budget. Group Content Fetch (GCF) exploits this layout to coalesce per-document random reads into batched, page-aware I/O requests. SICP works independently of the content layout, while RPAG and GCF reduce fetch cost even without prefetching. Across three multi-hop QA workloads with K from 10 to 1600, ConStore reduces end-to-end retrieval latency over the best per-document-read baseline by up to 48% on DiskANN and 25% on SPANN. Separate experiments on 100M- and billion-vector indexes demonstrate SICP's applicability at larger scales.
summary_zh: 大规模ANNS在大K值下，内容获取延迟与向量搜索相当甚至更高，成为端到端检索瓶颈。
提出ConStore存储引擎，结合搜索重叠预取（SICP）与共检索感知分组（RPAG及WASR），将随机读合并为批量I/O。
实验表明，ConStore在DiskANN和SPANN上最高降低端到端检索延迟48%和25%。

title: Enhancing Multimodal RLVR with Pairwise Token Contrast and Adaptive Trajectory Confidence
title_zh: 基于成对词元对比与自适应轨迹置信度的多模态RLVR增强
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves multimodal reasoning, but group-relative policy optimization broadcasts a single sequence-level advantage to every token of a response, although errors usually localize to a few decisive steps. Recent self-distilled variants refine credit with a teacher--student likelihood gap. However, this signal cannot tell whether it relies on the image or on a language shortcut, and is applied uniformly even when the teacher is uninformative. To address this, we propose Pairwise token contrast and Adaptive trajectory ConfidencE (PACE). Pairwise token contrast scores each response under four teacher views, crossing a correct or incorrect answer hint with the image present or removed, and compares the two hints for every token, which cancels shifts shared by both hints and reveals whether the token's support relies on the image. Adaptive trajectory confidence measures how well the teacher predicts each response given the correct hint and the image, normalizes this score within the batch, and uses it to set how far the token contrast redistributes credit within that response. PACE achieves the best average accuracy on three backbones and ranks first on all evaluated multimodal reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Experiments show that both components matter: replacing pairwise token contrast with a single-view signal underperforms our method, while adaptive trajectory confidence adds further improvement.
summary_zh: 多模态RLVR将序列级优势广播至所有词元，且自蒸馏信号无法区分视觉依赖与语言捷径，导致信用分配不准。
提出PACE方法：通过成对词元对比比较正误提示下的词元支持，消除共享偏移以揭示视觉依赖；用自适应轨迹置信度归一化教师预测分数，调节信用重分配程度。
PACE在三种主干网络及多模态推理基准上达到最佳平均准确率，消融实验证实成对对比与自适应置信度均不可或缺。

title: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
title_zh: Data World：从零构建可扩展的数据环境
abstract: Data agents use code to process heterogeneous files and derive analytical insights. Scaling their training faces costly environment curation, privacy and intellectual-property restrictions, and difficulty verifying open-ended findings without known generative truth. Our core insight is to specify the world behind the files before generating the files themselves. We introduce Data World, a multi-agent engine that synthesizes environments, tasks, and rubrics from explicit mechanisms. Independent audits check target recoverability from observed files; rubrics support evaluation and RL rewards. Human preference-based curation for question realism selects 100 tasks across 50 held-out worlds and 16 domains for DataWorld-Bench. The engine also yields 2,135 training tasks from 1,037 disjoint worlds. Evaluation of ten frontier models shows that the benchmark remains challenging, particularly for insight discovery, with a consistent computation-insight gap. RL-zero training on the synthesized tasks produces DataWorld-35B-A3B from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B without trajectory distillation. Under matched evaluation, it improves over its base by 7.06 points on DataWorld-Bench, 14.28 on DAComp, 20.90 on DABstep-Hard, and 12.13 on JobBench, a broader occupational benchmark.
summary_zh: 数据 agent 训练受限于环境构建成本、隐私限制及开放式发现难以验证的问题，本文提出先定义文件背后的世界机制再生成文件。
提出 Data World 引擎，从显式机制合成环境、任务与评分标准，通过独立审计确保目标可恢复性，评分标准支持评估与 RL 奖励。
基于合成任务进行 RL-zero 训练得到 DataWorld-35B-A3B 模型，在多个基准上较基座模型显著提升，验证了合成数据的有效性。
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/Zhanli-Li/Data-World/ Data: https://huggingface.co/collections/Zhanli-Li/dataworld Project page: https://zhanli-li.github.io/Data-World/

title: ReFlow: Replay-Driven Decoupling for Efficient RL Post-Training
title_zh: ReFlow：基于重放的解耦高效强化学习后训练
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been a critical paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning and agentic capabilities, but its efficiency remains a major bottleneck. Existing RL systems commonly rely on asynchronous execution to overlap rollout generation with policy optimization for enhanced efficiency. However, this approach faces inherent limitations: mild policy staleness offers only limited training efficiency gains, whereas aggressive asynchrony can degrade model quality and yields diminishing efficiency gains. The dynamic nature of LLM RL and multi-turn agentic workloads further challenges RL system design, as resource demands shift over time, making static resource allocation and generation strategy inefficient. This paper presents ReFlow, a system-algorithm co-designed RL framework for efficient LLM post-training. Its key insight is that, unlike existing RL frameworks which consume each trajectory only once, experience replay of recent trajectories enables effective sample reuse, thereby amortizing the high cost of rollout generation without incurring excessive policy staleness. To fully exploit this opportunity, ReFlow adopts a decoupled and adaptive architecture with three key designs: a dual replay data cycle supports efficient experience reuse while balancing training throughput and optimization stability; an elastic resource pool enables dynamic resource placement to accommodate evolving RL workloads; an adaptive scheduler coordinates generation strategies and resource allocation to improve resource utilization and boost generation throughput. Experiments across representative single-turn reasoning and multi-turn agentic RL tasks show that ReFlow improves training throughput by up to $2.06\times$ over state-of-the-art synchronous and asynchronous RL systems, while maintaining comparable or better model performance.
summary_zh: 现有LLM异步RL训练受限于策略延迟与静态资源分配，难以兼顾效率与模型质量。
提出ReFlow框架，通过经验重放复用轨迹分摊生成成本，并采用解耦自适应架构。
双循环重用平衡吞吐与稳定性，弹性资源池与自适应调度提升利用率，吞吐量最高提升2.06倍。

title: AgentPerturb: Evaluating LLM Agent Robustness under Controlled Interaction Perturbations
title_zh: AgentPerturb：受控交互扰动下的LLM智能体鲁棒性评估
abstract: Real-world tasks are often complex and noisy, posing substantial challenges for LLM agents. Yet existing evaluations lack a systematic framework for jointly characterizing potential perturbation targets and types. We use this two-dimensional view to conduct a unified study that quantifies the robustness of current frontier models, traces the mechanisms behind perturbation-induced failures, and draws implications for robustness-oriented training. Through controlled evaluations on APEX-Agents and Toolathlon, we find that perturbations consistently degrade performance, while the dominant vulnerabilities vary across task environments. Trajectory-level analysis reveals that agents rarely recognize altered inputs and often propagate corrupted information without verification. A focused cost analysis further shows that successful perturbed trajectories can require substantially more computation. These findings motivate training objectives that cover diverse forms of noise and reward verification, uncertainty awareness, and recovery. We provide a rigorous benchmark-construction pipeline. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/xuyj233/AgentPerturb.
summary_zh: 现有评估缺乏系统框架刻画LLM智能体的扰动目标与类型，本文从二维视角统一量化其鲁棒性并追溯失效机制。
受控评估表明扰动一致降低性能且主导脆弱性随环境而异；智能体极少识别输入篡改，常无验证地传播错误信息。
受扰成功轨迹需更多计算量，据此提出涵盖多样噪声的训练目标，并奖励验证、不确定性感知与恢复行为。

title: To Think or Not to Think: Pre-Decisional Reasoning Budgets for Referring Audio-Visual Segmentation
title_zh: 指代音视频分割的预决策推理预算研究
abstract: Multimodal reasoning systems increasingly assume that longer chain-of-thought (CoT) uniformly improves downstream grounding. We show that this assumption fails in referring audio-visual segmentation (Ref-AVS): simple queries can be harmed by excessive reasoning, creating an "overthinking trap" associated with phrase and localization drift, while genuinely ambiguous queries still benefit from multi-step reasoning. To systematically study this, we construct counterfactual reasoning-budget labels under a five-fold out-of-fold evaluation protocol. Our results recast adaptive Ref-AVS reasoning as a pre-decisional representation problem: before the first generated token, the generation-onset state contains linearly decodable information predictive of whether additional reasoning will improve segmentation. A linear probe predicts binary reasoning need with 70.1% accuracy, substantially outperforming text-only features and uncertainty-based proxy signals. As a router, the onset-state controller improves over downstream confidence routing and closely matches Short-then-Decide while using far fewer tokens. Proxy comparisons show that the onset representation contains predictive information not fully recovered by the evaluated hand-crafted features. Reusing this onset state for lightweight, single forward-pass routing reduces autoregressive token consumption by 60% while retaining about 96% of always-long performance. It further provides a cost-quality trade-off on $R^2$-AVSBench without target-label tuning, rather than an accuracy improvement over always-long. Error analysis links harmful long reasoning to phrase and localization drift, illustrating the benefit of bypassing unnecessary reasoning on simple queries. Ultimately, our results support efficient adaptive reasoning in Ref-AVS through pre-decisional internal representations.
summary_zh: 多模态推理中更长CoT并非总有益：Ref-AVS的简单查询会因过度推理陷入“过度思考陷阱”，而模糊查询仍受益于多步推理。
将自适应推理重构为预决策表示问题：生成起始状态包含可线性解码的信息，能预测额外推理是否会提升分割效果。
基于起始状态的轻量级路由器减少60%自回归token消耗，保留96%的始终长推理性能，实现高效自适应推理。

title: Evaluating Inquiry Learning in LLM-Based Agents: Hypothesizing, Reasoning, and Exploration
title_zh: 评估LLM智能体的探究学习：假设、推理与探索
abstract: Scientific inquiry involves iterative cycles of exploration, hypothesis generation, and reasoning over observations to uncover relationships in complex systems. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in several components of this process, including inductive reasoning, hypothesis generation, and data analysis. However, prior work typically evaluates these abilities in isolation, leaving open how models integrate them across a full inquiry cycle. In this work, we introduce a framework for evaluating LLMs' inquiry capabilities in a unified, interactive setting. We extend the Countdown task to a mathematical environment where an agent probes the system by manipulating variables, collecting observations, and inferring relationships between them. This setup enables analysis of exploration strategies, causal discovery, and hypothesis refinement during inquiry. Across seven LLMs and multiple prompting strategies, our experiments reveal limited inherent inquiry capabilities and low success rates in discovering the underlying expressions. However, structured guidance inspired by educational scaffolding significantly improves performance. Our findings highlight current limitations of LLMs in strategic exploration and iterative hypothesis refinement, and show how simple guidance strategies developed for human learners in inquiry learning can support more effective inquiry behavior.
summary_zh: 现有研究孤立评估LLM的推理等能力，未考察其在完整探究周期中的整合能力，故需统一评估框架。
提出基于扩展Countdown任务的交互式评估框架，让智能体通过操纵变量与收集观察来推断关系，以分析其探究策略。
实验表明LLM固有探究能力有限且成功率低，但引入借鉴教育支架的结构化引导可显著提升性能，改善探索与假设迭代。

title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: Waypoint-OPD：通过门控在线蒸馏迁移强化学习策略偏移
abstract: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.
summary_zh: 现有策略偏移蒸馏仅利用RL前后端点差异，忽略了局部动作偏好演变的一致性，端点偏移可能因早晚变化相抵消而具误导性。
提出Waypoint-OPD方法，利用中间检查点对比早晚策略偏移方向，依其一致性对端点偏移施加门控，抑制方向相反的偏移迁移。
在数学与代码推理任务中，Waypoint-OPD在六种配置下均取得最高域平均分，消融实验验证了门控机制的有效性。

title: Hear, Localize, and Reason: Spatially Aware Scene Understanding for Audio-Visual LLMs
title_zh: 面向视听LLM的听觉-定位-推理空间感知场景理解
abstract: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) have made strong progress in multimodal understanding, yet most treat audio as monaural semantic content, limiting their ability to reason about where sounds originate and how they relate to the visual scene. Recent spatial audio-visual studies address parts of this problem, but often focus on specific abilities, such as spatial correspondence or direction and distance reasoning. In this work, we introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark with a hear-localize-reason hierarchy that evaluates whether models can recognize what is heard, localize sound sources in egocentric and allocentric views, and use these localized sources to reason about how they relate to the visual scene. We further introduce HLR-LLM, which augments a strong audio-visual foundation model with a binaural spatial audio branch alongside its monaural semantic audio pathway. We train HLR-LLM with a curriculum that incorporates final-stage chain-of-thought supervision for multi-step spatial reasoning. Experiments show that existing AV-LLMs remain limited in spatial grounding and relational reasoning, while HLR-LLM substantially improves spatial audio-visual scene understanding without compromising semantic audio-visual perception.
summary_zh: 现有视听LLM多将音频作单耳语义内容，缺乏空间定位与视听关联推理能力。
提出HLR-AVSceneQA基准，按听-定位-推理层级评估模型识别、定位及关联推理能力。
引入双耳空间音频分支构建HLR-LLM，结合思维链监督训练，显著提升空间理解且不损语义感知。

title: ClaimScope: Label-Blind Witness Verification for Mathematical Claim Auditing
title_zh: ClaimScope：数学命题审计的标签无关见证验证
abstract: Mathematical agents are commonly evaluated by answer accuracy or proof acceptance. We introduce ClaimScope, a 72-task benchmark for auditing proposed claims through a verdict, scope, counterexample, and repair. Tasks cover optimizer-state transport, finite-horizon affine recurrences, and exact $2\times2$ linear algebra. We evaluate Qwen3-8B with direct generation and four matched two-pass conditions, each starting from the same draft. A witness checker evaluates only the model's submitted state, without consulting reference verdicts or supplying a replacement witness. Its feedback still conveys information about validity: a verified refutation establishes that the claim is false, and rejection reasons can suggest structural fixes. In this evaluation, verifier feedback yields $23/39$ accepted counterexamples on invalid claims and $25/72$ safe completions, compared with $15/39$ and $20/72$ for checker-free generic feedback. Strict completion remains $17/72$; verdict accuracy changes from $47/72$ to $46/72$. The claim-grouped safe-completion difference is $.094$, with a bootstrap 95\% interval of $[.000,.198]$. All seven task-level gains follow horizon/input-length diagnostics. A post-hoc schema-only correction of the direct outputs reaches the same 25 safe tasks without another model call. These results separate claim classification from executable evidence, while locating the observed gains in witness-structure correction rather than demonstrating broader reasoning improvement.
summary_zh: 现有数学智能体评估仅看答案或证明，缺乏对命题有效性与结构的审计，故提出ClaimScope基准。
该基准含72个任务，通过见证检查器仅评估模型提交的状态，不依赖参考标签即可验证反驳与修复。
实验表明见证反馈提升了无效命题反例和安全完成率，但收益源于结构修正而非推理能力的提升。
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Mathematical Reasoning and AI)

title: MYOPIA: Understanding the Limits of Tree-Based Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 视觉语言模型中树状推理的局限性探究
abstract: Decision trees can make vision-language model (VLM) classification interpretable by replacing a single prediction with a sequence of root-to-leaf questions. However, the accuracy cost of this greedy, non-backtracking procedure remains unclear. We introduce \textbf{MYOPIA}, a benchmark comprising four LLM-generated, human-refined decision trees for GTSRB, MNIST, CIFAR-10, and MSCOCO, together with matched prompts, diagnostic protocols, and an evaluation harness. Across GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision, tree traversal underperforms zero-shot prompting in all 12 dataset--model pairs; paired bootstrap analyses consistently favor zero-shot. Our diagnostics characterize interacting failure modes associated with this gap. Models often recall tree-encoded class attributes more accurately than they ground the same attributes in images: the mean label--image accuracy gaps are 9.5, 13.8, and 12.6 points for GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA, respectively. Incorrect local decisions then irreversibly exclude the correct class, while answer extraction introduces additional model-dependent loss. A node-level audit of the four trees finds that split entropy is weakly but consistently associated with lower node accuracy, whereas depth, branching factor, and within-node grounding differences are less stable. \textbf{MYOPIA} therefore provides a framework for diagnosing hierarchical visual classification and motivates testing tree designs that prioritize perceptual answerability and recovery from early errors. Code is available at https://github.com/islammesabah/VLM_Classification.
summary_zh: VLM的树状分类推理缺乏回溯，其准确率代价不明，需量化评估该贪心策略的性能损失。
构建MYOPIA基准，在12个数据集-模型对上测试，发现树遍历分类均逊于零样本提示。
诊断发现模型属性召回优于图像定位，局部误判不可逆排除正确类，为优化树设计提供依据。

title: Rethinking the Role of Tool Graph Memory in Multi-Turn Tool Use
title_zh: 重新思考多轮工具使用中工具图记忆的作用
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks by calling external tools over multiple turns. Recent work has proposed tool graph memory, which stores past experience as tool transitions to guide subsequent selection. However, it remains unclear whether this component consistently improves agents' tool use or undermines it. We evaluate tool graph memory on nine models and two benchmarks, finding that it seldom improves significantly over baselines, and that its gains, where present, cost over twice the LLM calls. The memory's guidance is often incorrect, and random or no guidance retains most of the gain, implying that the benefit stems from extra computation rather than the memory itself. Moreover, even with the correct next tool suggested, many failures remain, such as giving up without a tool call. Storing the same experience instead as textual insights outperforms tool graph memory with almost no extra LLM calls. This suggests that memory serves better as a soft prior than as a prescription of the next tool, leading to a more effective and generalizable solution.
summary_zh: 多轮工具使用中，工具图记忆能否有效指导工具选择尚不明确，需评估其实际效用。
跨模型与基准测试发现，工具图记忆极少显著提升基线，且收益伴随超两倍LLM调用开销；其指导常出错，收益实为额外计算而非记忆本身。
将经验存为文本见解优于工具图记忆且无额外开销，表明记忆更适合作为软先验而非硬性指定，更具泛化性。

title: Independent Data-Integrity Verification for LLM-Driven Functional Coverage Closure in Hardware Design
title_zh: 硬件设计中LLM功能覆盖闭合的独立数据完整性验证
abstract: LLM agents can write directed tests that close functional coverage, but coverage only shows that a state was reached, not that the data on the way there was correct. This is a long-known point in verification and we do not claim it as new. We describe a small coverage-closure agent that applies it to an LLM loop: coverage is read from the report that the simulation itself exports (cocotb-coverage YAML) and never taken from the model's account, and data integrity is checked by scoreboards that are separate from the model. On three architecturally distinct RTL designs (an asynchronous FIFO, a UART transmitter and an AHB2APB bridge) the agent raised coverage from 91.7%, 88.9% and 67.4% to 100% within its 8-iteration budget in every logged run, using one design-agnostic agent. A reactive scoreboard monitor attached to the FIFO's base testbench also found a clock-domain-crossing bug in the author's own stimulus code. The monitor is not yet attached to the LLM-generated tests, so their data integrity is not independently checked; one manual check on a single FIFO test is reported as preliminary. We list the weaknesses of this evidence: three designs, no baseline, no ablation, and logged runs that come from several agent checkpoints.
summary_zh: LLM agent闭合功能覆盖仅表明状态到达，无法保证数据正确性，需独立验证。
提出一种覆盖闭合agent，从仿真报告读取覆盖，并用独立记分板检查数据完整性。
在三种RTL设计上将覆盖提至100%，并发现一跨时钟域bug，但LLM测试的完整性尚未独立验证。

title: Numerical simulations of low-mass black hole-neutron star mergers with moderate eccentricities
title_zh: 中等偏心率低质量黑洞-中子星并合的数值模拟
abstract: A confident detection of orbital eccentricity in gravitational-wave signals from black hole-neutron star systems would be a strong indicator of their dynamical formation origin. While eccentric waveform models have recently been developed, their validity for analyzing black hole--neutron star signals has yet to be tested against numerical-relativity simulations. Building upon our previous study of quasicircular black hole--neutron star mergers, we perform simulations of a subset of these systems with orbital eccentricities around five times larger than those inferred for GW200105_162426. Additionally, we perform simulations with magnetized matter to assess whether trapped $g$-mode oscillations persist in strongly magnetized disks. Regarding the emitted gravitational-wave signal, we find that the effective one-body waveform model SEOBNRv5EHM shows reasonable agreement unless tidal contributions become important, and the inspiral-only post-Newtonian models pyEFPE/pyEFPEHM show larger disagreement in the late inspiral. For the equal-mass system, which has the largest effective tidal deformability, eccentric tidal corrections have a small but noticeable impact on the phase, $\sim0.1$ rad. We find an almost negligible impact of eccentricity on the properties of the remnant black hole, and differences of up to a factor of two in the remnant disk mass. Trapped $g$ modes in the accretion disks have the same frequency regardless of the eccentricity, confirming that they depend mainly on the properties of the remnant black hole. We find that when accretion disks are strongly magnetized, they become less dense and have less pronounced structure, and that the trapped $g$ modes previously identified in the unmagnetized cases are efficiently damped.
summary_zh: 现有偏心率波形模型未针对黑洞-中子星信号验证，本文模拟了具有中等偏心率的此类系统并合。
引力波分析表明，SEOBNRv5EHM模型在潮汐贡献不显著时表现合理，偏心潮汐修正对相位有约0.1弧度影响。
偏心率对残余黑洞性质影响极小，但残余盘质量差异可达两倍；强磁场会抑制盘密度并有效阻尼捕获g模。
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, to be submitted to PRD

title: Reinforcement Learning-driven Diffusion Models: Language, Vision, and Beyond
title_zh: 强化学习驱动的扩散模型：语言、视觉及更多领域
abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) have steadily demonstrated outstanding performance in high-fidelity, controllable generation across diverse scenarios, following the "pretraining-finetuning" paradigm established in LLMs. Despite these advances, conventional DMs still face critical limitations in sophisticated reasoning, autonomous exploration of generation pathways, and adaptability to complex, human-aligned objectives. Inspired by RLHF's success in LLMs, RL has recently emerged as a pivotal post-training mechanism to iteratively refine DMs through reward-driven trajectory optimization. This paper presents the first comprehensive review of RL-driven DMs and an empirical analysis of how RL reshapes the diffusion process towards experience-centric, goal-directed generation. We propose a novel technical panorama elucidating RL's multifaceted roles in diffusion-based language, multimodal, robotic, and scientific models, with a granular focus on diffusion trajectory optimization and reward engineering. Through extensive experiments on multiple task-specific benchmarks, we systematically evaluate representative methods to intuitively highlight the advantages of different RL post-training strategies. Furthermore, we reveal and dissect three crucial bottlenecks that currently hinder the real-world deployment of RL-driven DMs: reward design fragility, exploration-exploitation trade-off in high-dimensional generation spaces, and training instability under sparse rewards. Based on these perspectives, we provide a principled roadmap for the integration of RL into DMs and outline promising future research directions for robust, interpretable RL-diffusion systems. We also construct a public repository to continuously track the latest developments in this rapidly evolving field: https://github.com/MAIR-Lab-HUST/Awesome-RL-for-Diffusion-Models.
summary_zh: 传统扩散模型在复杂推理与人类目标对齐上存在局限，引入RL作为后训练机制，通过奖励驱动优化迭代优化扩散轨迹。
本文首次全面综述RL驱动的扩散模型，提出技术全景图，并在多任务基准上系统评估不同RL后训练策略的优势。
揭示奖励设计脆弱性、高维空间探索与利用权衡、稀疏奖励下训练不稳定三大瓶颈，为构建鲁棒系统提供未来路线图。

title: Agent Status Protocol (ASP): A Lightweight Specification for State Reporting in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: Agent状态协议：多智能体系统的轻量级状态报告规范
abstract: The Agent Status Protocol (ASP) defines a lightweight way for heterogeneous AI agents to report their operational state to a status server, and for observers such as dashboards to receive that state as soon as it changes. Agents push small JSON events over HTTP POST; the server exposes the aggregated state to observers over Server-Sent Events (SSE). Because an agent that has crashed, hung or been compromised cannot be trusted to report its own failure, ASP does not rely on self-reports alone: the server infers liveness from missed heartbeats, can detect agents that are alive but no longer making progress, and accepts observations from supervisors, guardrails, operators and peers, some of which take precedence over what the agent says about itself while others are shown alongside it. ASP models state along independent dimensions (lifecycle, health, task, floor, governance), so that an agent can be, for example, online, degraded, working on a task and waiting for the floor at the same time. It reuses existing vocabularies: task states from the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, floor states from the Open Floor Protocol (OFP), and attribute conventions from the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions. This paper presents version 0.1 of ASP as a proposal, not as an approved standard. It is a working draft intended to open a discussion, and the authors invite comments, alternative proposals and independent implementations from the community.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统中异构agent状态报告缺乏轻量统一规范，提出ASP协议，通过HTTP POST与SSE实现状态实时推送与聚合。
agent崩溃或被入侵时自报不可靠，ASP引入心跳推断、外部监督观察机制，并沿生命周期等独立维度建模状态。
ASP复用A2A、OFP及OpenTelemetry等现有词汇表，发布v0.1工作草案以邀请社区讨论与替代方案。

title: Functional Subnetwork Localization for Efficient Continual Learning in Large Language Models
title_zh: 大语言模型中基于功能子网络定位的高效持续学习
abstract: Biological intelligence continually adapts to new information while retaining prior skills through localized plasticity. In contrast, continual learning in large language models (LLMs) remains vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. A promising direction is to identify functionally specialized subnetworks within LLMs that enable targeted and resource-efficient adaptation. Using gradient-attribution profiling, we localize cognition-associated functional subnetworks exhibiting extremely low mutual overlap. Building on this finding, we propose Function-isolated Memory-Efficient Optimization (CiMEO), a continual learning framework that routes each training example to its corresponding functional subnetwork, restricting parameter updates and optimizer states to selected regions. Across 1.4 million sequential instructions, CiMEO achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods on five generative benchmarks spanning programming, examination-style tasks, and mathematical reasoning, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Subspace-overlap and principal-angle analyses further indicate that localized updates help preserve pre-trained representations, highlighting functional subnetwork localization as a practical approach to efficient and stable continual learning in LLMs.
summary_zh: LLM持续学习易灾难性遗忘，借鉴生物局部可塑性，提出定位功能特化子网络以实现高效适配。
通过梯度归因定位认知子网络，发现其重叠极低；提出CiMEO框架，将训练样本路由至对应子网络并限制参数更新。
在140万指令实验中，CiMEO在多领域生成基准上性能最优，有效缓解遗忘，证明子网络定位的实用性。

title: QREF: Improving DeepSearch Agents by Aligning Search with Reasoning via Query Refinement and Evidence Filtering
title_zh: QREF：通过查询精炼与证据过滤对齐搜索与推理
abstract: DeepSearch agents achieve strong performance on complex information-seeking tasks through iterative search and reasoning. However, they often issue intent-misaligned, under-constrained, or redundant search queries, resulting in poor evidence coverage and accumulating retrieval noise. To mitigate these limitations, we propose QREF, a plug-and-play Query Refiner and Evidence Filter. Specifically, the Query Refiner rewrites search queries according to the current reasoning intent while ensuring complementary coverage across each search batch. The Evidence Filter retains evidence relevant to both the current search batch and the reasoning objective, reducing distracting retrieval results. We initialize the Query Refiner with supervised fine-tuning and optimize it through reinforcement learning based on interactions with a real-world web search environment, reducing ineffective queries. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our approach improves the performance of DeepSearch agents across four challenging benchmarks, achieving average relative Pass@1 improvements of 33.55% on WebSailor and 11.04% on TongyiDeepResearch without modifying architectures or retraining their reasoning policies. Compared with the original DeepSearch backbone without QREF, the RL-trained refiner reduces the fraction of query batches that lack discriminative retrieval anchors by 95%. Compared with the SFT-trained refiner, it also lowers the filter-based ineffective query ratio.
summary_zh: DeepSearch agent易生成意图不符或冗余的查询，导致证据覆盖差且检索噪声累积。
提出即插即用模块QREF，含查询精炼器与证据过滤器，分别重写查询对齐推理意图并过滤无关证据。
实验表明QREF显著提升agent性能，在两基准上Pass@1平均相对提升超11%，且大幅减少无效查询。

title: Receiver-Specific Interventional Valuation of Semantic Atoms for Budget-Constrained Multi-Agent Communication
title_zh: 预算受限多智能体通信的接收者特定语义原子干预评估
abstract: Cooperative multi-agent semantic communication requires deciding not only how a transmitter encodes its observation, but also which resulting semantic content should be delivered to each receiver under a limited link budget. We introduce an encoder-agnostic transmitter-side framework for receiver-specific valuation of independently selectable semantic units, termed semantic atoms. Each atom is assigned a signed value that quantifies whether delivering it is expected to improve or degrade the intended receiver's downstream decision. We formulate this effect through a controlled-delivery utility and identify it via prospective randomized payload delivery before the receiver acts. A shadow receiver estimates this utility using only transmitter-available information, from which receiver-specific leave-one-out (LOO) and Shapley atom values are computed. Experiments on a four-receiver intersection benchmark show 68.4% accuracy in recovering the sign of non-negligible LOO atom effects and a Spearman correlation of 0.302 between estimated and reference LOO values. Under limited budgets, we show that receiver-specific selection consistently outperforms shared and random alternatives, demonstrating the benefit of adapting semantic ranking to the intended receiver. At full affordability, exhaustive subset selection also outperforms full-payload transmission, showing that transmitting all available content need not maximize receiver utility. Overall, our results show that receiver-specific semantic valuation can support effective budget-constrained communication despite imperfect atom-value estimation.
summary_zh: 多智能体语义通信需在有限预算下决定向各接收者传递何种语义内容，现有方法缺乏针对接收者的内容价值评估。
提出编码器无关的发射端框架，通过受控交付效用与影子接收者，计算接收者特定的LOO与Shapley语义原子值。
实验表明，接收者特定的语义选择在有限预算下持续优于共享或随机方案，且全量传输未必最大化接收效用。

title: OPRD: On-Policy Reminder Distillation for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
title_zh: 长周期编程智能体的同策略提醒蒸馏
abstract: Reliable repository-level coding requires agents not only to generate correct code but also to preserve constraints and respond to tool feedback across long interactions. However, our diagnostic analysis shows that agents often fail to act on relevant information already available in context, while final Pass/Fail outcomes provide only sparse process supervision. We introduce On-Policy Reminder Distillation (OPRD), which combines Multi-Scope Reminder supervision with outcome-based routing on reminder-free student rollouts. Successful rollouts provide autoregressive self-imitation targets, whereas failed rollouts receive Reminder-conditioned reverse-KL supervision from a teacher that re-evaluates the same student-generated prefixes. A Global Reminder converts final-test diagnostics into trajectory-level guidance, while Turn-local Reminders apply only to the next decision following the relevant environment observation. The teacher and student share a two-stage initialization from Coding SFT and Instruction-Following (IF) SFT. At inference, the student operates without Reminders. On SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Pro, and SWE-bench Multilingual, OPRD improves the benchmark-averaged task resolution rate by 11.3 points over the open-source Qwen3.5-4B base model. Under the same diagnostic protocol, it reduces the aggregate error-event count from 446 to 222, a 50.2% reduction.
summary_zh: 长周期编程中，智能体常忽略上下文已有信息，且最终结果仅提供稀疏的过程监督。
提出OPRD方法，结合多范围提醒监督与基于结果的路由，对失败轨迹用教师模型提供反向KL监督。
OPRD在多基准上平均任务解决率提升11.3%，错误事件减少50.2%，推理时无需提醒。
全局提醒提供轨迹级指导，局部提醒作用于环境观测后的下一步决策，师生模型共享两阶段SFT初始化。

title: Context Matters! Social, Spatial, and Semantic Coordination with an Embodied Agent in Immersive Analytics
title_zh: 沉浸式分析中具身智能体的社会、空间与语义协调
abstract: Embodied AI agents in Augmented Reality (AR) could enable more natural collaboration in immersive analytics by engaging users through spatial, conversational, and visual interaction. However, designing such agents requires careful attention to context. We propose a preliminary conceptual framework for context-aware design of embodied agents structured around three dimensions of spatial, social, and semantic. This framework is further categorised into embeddedness (how agents are situated in the contexts) and awareness (how agents perceive and respond to the contexts). To explore this, we present Cobot, an embodied AI agent designed as a design probe. Cobot supports context-sensitive interaction through features such as gaze cues, spatial sound, and task-aware behaviour. We reflect on its design and identify implications for future contextaware embodied agents.
summary_zh: AR中具身AI智能体能实现自然协作，但设计时需充分考量上下文环境。
提出上下文感知设计概念框架，围绕空间、社会和语义三个维度，并划分为嵌入性与感知性。
开发具身智能体Cobot作为设计探针，支持注视、空间音频等上下文交互，并反思其设计启示。
comment: In 2025 IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality Adjunct (ISMAR-Adjunct) (pp. 189-194). IEEE

title: Tool-Augmented Large Language Models for Reliable Medical Calculation from Patient Notes
title_zh: 基于工具增强LLM的可靠患者笔记医疗计算框架
abstract: Medical calculators translate raw patient observations into clinically actionable values and scores. However, applying these calculators directly to free-form patient notes requires precise variable extraction combined with the exact execution of complex formulas, scoring rules, and output conventions. Relying solely on direct large language model (LLM) prompting is unreliable in this context, as rule recall, parameter extraction, arithmetic reasoning, and formatting become entangled within a single generative step. To address these limitations, we propose a tool-augmented LLM framework for reliable medical calculation from patient notes. The framework retrieves and structures calculator specifications, generates reusable executable tools, and uses a constrained extractor to map each patient note to calculator-ready inputs. The tools then perform deterministic calculation, separating clinical language understanding from rule execution and arithmetic. Evaluated on the MedCalc-Bench dataset, our method achieves 86.73% final-answer accuracy, outperforming the one-shot prompting and supervised fine tuning-only baselines by 24.0 and 17.27 percentage points. Ablation and error analyses show that these performance gains are primarily driven by rule-grounded tool synthesis and schema-constrained extraction, whereas remaining failures are concentrated in clinical-semantic extraction and benchmark-specific output contracts. By grounding calculator logic in executable tools, the proposed approach alleviates arithmetic hallucinations and improves the computational reliability of the final clinical outputs.
summary_zh: 直接用LLM从自由文本提取变量并执行医疗计算易因推理与计算纠缠而出错。
提出工具增强LLM框架，生成可执行工具并利用受限提取器映射输入，实现确定性计算。
在MedCalc-Bench上准确率达86.73%，显著超越基线，有效缓解算术幻觉。
comment: Accepted as a regular paper at BIBM2026

title: Poisoning the Neighborhood: A Topology-Aware Topic-Level Attack on Large-Scale HNSW-based RAG Systems
title_zh: 针对大规模HNSW-RAG系统的拓扑感知主题级投毒攻击
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates hallucinations and knowledge staleness in large language models using external knowledge. However, ingestion from public and third-party sources exposes RAG systems to poisoning attacks. Existing attacks are designed and evaluated under exact retrieval, where poisoned documents participate in global ranking. Deployment-scale systems instead rely on approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) indexes such as hierarchical navigable small world (HNSW), where limited search budgets, graph-search reachability, and local benign-document competition invalidate this assumption and degrade existing attacks. We present a topology-aware topic-level poisoning attack against large-scale HNSW-RAG that generalizes to unseen topic queries. We organize poisoned documents into a Hub-Satellite structure: Satellites provide competitive entry points across semantic regions, while Hubs strengthen local cohesion and facilitate cascading retrieval. For generation, we propose an entity-claim promotion attack combining evidence anchoring and entity-claim coupling to promote the target entity via a target claim across different query regions. On 2M-document Wikipedia, our attack maintains over 72% retrieval success and reaches 31.29% attack success, substantially outperforming baselines; domain-specific experiments further support its effectiveness. Structural analyses show that the Hub-Satellite topology forms in HNSW, indicating that graph structure contributes to improved poisoned-document retrieval. Existing poisoning defenses cannot mitigate the attack, exposing graph-structural risks in HNSW-RAG systems.
summary_zh: 现有RAG投毒攻击基于精确检索假设，在采用HNSW索引的大规模系统中因搜索预算和图可达性限制而失效。
提出拓扑感知主题级投毒攻击，构建Hub-Satellite结构增强局部内聚与级联检索，并结合实体-声明提升攻击影响生成。
在200万维基文档上攻击成功率达31.29%，现有防御无法缓解，暴露了HNSW-RAG的图结构风险。

title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
title_zh: 基于轨迹推测与语义验证的工具调用Agent协议
abstract: Large language model agents solve tasks through long sequences of tool calls, and the prevailing design has a single strong model generate every step, although many steps are routine enough for a much smaller model. Existing ways of sharing this work keep the strong model as the generator: routers and collaborative agents decide which model handles each query or step, and speculative methods check a small model's drafts one step at a time, usually against the strong model's own action. We introduce SpecAgent, a collaboration protocol that turns the strong model from the author of each step into a reviewer of steps drafted by a weak model. The weak model executes read-only tool calls as it drafts, so that every step is grounded in real observations, and holds the first action that would modify the environment. The strong model then verifies the drafted segment in a single prefill pass, commits the longest prefix it judges semantically valid, and repairs the first rejected step. Because verification replaces autoregressive decoding with parallel prefill, the strong model decodes only short verdicts and occasional repairs rather than every step. On $τ^2$-Bench, SpecAgent comes within one point of the strong model's success rate while roughly halving memory traffic and wall time, and on AutomationBench and VitaBench it recovers 44-75% of the quality gap while lowering both. In an edge-cloud deployment on MCP-Atlas with three cloud models, it closes 53-75% of the weak-strong quality gap while the strong model generates at most half as many tokens. These results suggest that a strong model need not author every step of an agent: reviewing grounded drafts retains most of its quality while cutting both latency and memory traffic.
summary_zh: LLM Agent逐步调用工具时全由强模型生成效率低，多数常规步骤弱模型即可胜任。
提出SpecAgent协议，由弱模型执行只读工具生成轨迹草案，强模型单次并行预填验证并修复。
验证替代自回归解码，强模型仅输出短判定与修复。实验表明该协议在大幅降低延迟和内存的同时，恢复了44-75%的质量差距。

title: What Survives Self-Evolution: Provenance Marks in Copied Agent Harnesses
title_zh: 智能体框架泄露后的溯源标记存活研究
abstract: Agent harnesses, the prompt and tool code around a base model, leak. Claude Code's 512,000 lines were mirrored within hours of a packaging error. A plagiarist can pass a leaked harness through a published self-evolver and ship the result as its own. We define this as a covert rewriting attack. No one targets a provenance mark, yet a large language model (LLM) proposer rewrites the file that carries it and a score keeps the better rewrites. We give the first measurement of marks under this attack, with three evolvers, five proposers and two environments. Published marks fail. KGW in the prompt survives GEPA's rewrites in 0 of 12 copies, AgentMark as released in 5 of 12. The proposer's habits decide survival, by two orders of magnitude across models, and selection protects a mark only when each decision sees enough games. We then build a mark for this attack. Its key is the order of near-tied entries of a table of where objects are found, built from public games, so deleting the table costs success, rewrites that keep its rows keep the order, and a customer reads the key from the agent's actions alone. On held-out games it is detected in 62 of 76 copies whose lineage rewrote its file. A scheme-aware plagiarist reshuffles the ties at no measurable cost, and a plagiarist who asks the proposer for more general code removes the key in 75-100% of rewrites.
summary_zh: 智能体框架易泄露并被隐蔽重写攻击，现有溯源标记在自演化重写下几乎全部失效。
